===== FILE: \app\Services\AuthCodeService.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\AuthCode;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthCodeService
{
    public const PURPOSE_VERIFY_EMAIL = 'verify_email';
    public const PURPOSE_PASSWORD_RESET = 'password_reset';
    public const TTL_MINUTES = 10;
    public const RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 60;
    public const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

    /**
     * @return array{code:string, expires_at:string, retry_after:int}
     */
    public function issue(User $user, string $purpose): array
    {
        $email = mb_strtolower(trim((string) $user->email));

        if ($email === '' || str_ends_with($email, '@ohmybaby.local')) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => ['هذا الحساب لا يملك بريداً إلكترونياً صالحاً لإرسال الرمز.'],
            ]);
        }

        $latest = AuthCode::query()
            ->where('email', $email)
            ->where('purpose', $purpose)
            ->whereNull('consumed_at')
            ->latest('id')
            ->first();

        // Cooldown applies only while the latest code is still active.
        // If the code is already expired, the user must be able to request
        // a replacement immediately instead of being locked out.
        if ($latest?->created_at && $latest->expires_at?->isFuture()) {
            $elapsed = (int) floor($latest->created_at->diffInSeconds(now()));
            if ($elapsed < self::RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS) {
                $remaining = max(1, self::RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS - $elapsed);
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'email' => ["انتظر {$remaining} ثانية قبل طلب رمز جديد."],
                ]);
            }
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($user, $email, $purpose) {
            AuthCode::query()
                ->where('email', $email)
                ->where('purpose', $purpose)
                ->whereNull('consumed_at')
                ->update(['consumed_at' => now()]);

            $code = (string) random_int(100000, 999999);
            $expiresAt = now()->addMinutes(self::TTL_MINUTES);

            AuthCode::create([
                'user_id' => $user->id,
                'email' => $email,
                'purpose' => $purpose,
                'code_hash' => Hash::make($code),
                'expires_at' => $expiresAt,
                'attempts' => 0,
            ]);

            AuthCode::query()
                ->where('expires_at', '<', now()->subDay())
                ->delete();

            return [
                'code' => $code,
                'expires_at' => $expiresAt->toIso8601String(),
                'retry_after' => self::RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
            ];
        });
    }

    public function verify(User $user, string $purpose, string $code): void
    {
        $email = mb_strtolower(trim((string) $user->email));

        DB::transaction(function () use ($user, $email, $purpose, $code) {
            $record = AuthCode::query()
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->where('email', $email)
                ->where('purpose', $purpose)
                ->whereNull('consumed_at')
                ->latest('id')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if (! $record || $record->expires_at->isPast()) {
                if ($record && is_null($record->consumed_at)) {
                    $record->forceFill(['consumed_at' => now()])->save();
                }

                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'code' => ['انتهت صلاحية الرمز. اطلب رمزاً جديداً.'],
                ]);
            }

            if ($record->attempts >= self::MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
                $record->forceFill(['consumed_at' => now()])->save();

                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'code' => ['تم تجاوز عدد المحاولات المسموح. اطلب رمزاً جديداً.'],
                ]);
            }

            $record->increment('attempts');
            $record->refresh();

            if (! Hash::check($code, $record->code_hash)) {
                if ($record->attempts >= self::MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
                    $record->forceFill(['consumed_at' => now()])->save();
                }

                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'code' => ['رمز التحقق غير صحيح.'],
                ]);
            }

            $record->forceFill(['consumed_at' => now()])->save();
        });
    }
}


===== FILE: \app\Services\CatalogInventoryService.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\CatalogProduct;
use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class CatalogInventoryService
{
    public function inventoryKey(?string $colorId, ?string $size): string
    {
        return ($colorId ?: 'default').'::'.($size ?: 'default');
    }

    public function reserve(CatalogProduct $product, ?string $colorId, ?string $size, int $quantity): array
    {
        $inventory = $product->inventory ?: [];
        $key = $this->inventoryKey($colorId, $size);
        $stock = max(0, (int) ($inventory[$key] ?? 0));

        if ($quantity > $stock) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'items' => ["الكمية المتوفرة من {$product->name_ar} هي {$stock} فقط لهذا اللون والقياس."],
            ]);
        }

        $inventory[$key] = $stock - $quantity;
        $product->inventory = $inventory;
        $product->save();

        return ['key' => $key, 'remaining' => $inventory[$key]];
    }

    public function restoreOrder(Order $order): void
    {
        $order->loadMissing('items');

        foreach ($order->items as $item) {
            if (! $item->catalog_product_id || ! $item->inventory_key || $item->stock_restored_at) {
                continue;
            }

            $product = CatalogProduct::whereKey($item->catalog_product_id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            if (! $product) {
                continue;
            }

            $inventory = $product->inventory ?: [];
            $inventory[$item->inventory_key] = max(0, (int) ($inventory[$item->inventory_key] ?? 0)) + (int) $item->quantity;
            $product->inventory = $inventory;
            $product->save();

            $item->stock_restored_at = now();
            $item->save();
        }
    }
}


===== FILE: \app\Services\CommissionService.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\CommissionTransfer;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;

class CommissionService
{
    public function __construct(
        private ShamCashService $shamCash,
        private FinancialLedgerService $ledger,
    ) {}

    public function ensureForDeliveredOrder(Order $order): CommissionTransfer
    {
        $order->loadMissing(['items', 'acceptedBy', 'events.actor']);

        // Financial debt starts only after BOTH sides confirm: Delivery has marked
        // the order delivered and the Customer has confirmed receipt.
        if (! $order->delivered_at || ! $order->customer_confirmed_at) {
            return $order->commission()->firstOrCreate(
                ['order_id' => $order->id],
                [
                    'type' => 'awaiting_customer_confirmation',
                    'amount_usd' => 0,
                    'status' => 'awaiting_confirmation',
                    'provider' => 'internal_ledger',
                ],
            );
        }

        $hasDecoration = $order->items->contains(fn ($item) => $item->category === 'decor');
        $hasOffer = $order->items->contains(fn ($item) => (bool) $item->is_offer);

        // Decoration uses a separate settlement flow that the Owner asked to build later.
        // Keep it visible/auditable now, but do NOT charge the normal Admin ledger yet.
        if ($hasDecoration) {
            return CommissionTransfer::updateOrCreate(
                ['order_id' => $order->id],
                [
                    'debtor_user_id' => null,
                    'type' => 'decoration_deferred',
                    'amount_usd' => (float) config('ohmybaby.commissions.decoration_usd', 2.5),
                    'status' => 'deferred',
                    'provider' => 'internal_ledger',
                    'failure_reason' => null,
                ],
            );
        }

        if ($hasOffer && config('ohmybaby.commissions.exclude_orders_with_offers', true)) {
            return CommissionTransfer::updateOrCreate(
                ['order_id' => $order->id],
                [
                    'debtor_user_id' => null,
                    'type' => 'offer_excluded',
                    'amount_usd' => 0,
                    'status' => 'excluded',
                    'provider' => 'internal_ledger',
                    'failure_reason' => null,
                ],
            );
        }

        $amount = (float) config('ohmybaby.commissions.normal_order_usd', 0.5);
        $debtor = $this->resolveDebtor($order);

        $commission = CommissionTransfer::firstOrNew(['order_id' => $order->id]);
        $commission->fill([
            'debtor_user_id' => $debtor?->id,
            'type' => 'normal_order',
            'amount_usd' => $amount,
            'provider' => 'internal_ledger',
            'failure_reason' => $debtor ? null : 'No responsible Admin could be resolved for this order.',
        ]);

        if (! $commission->exists || in_array($commission->status, ['awaiting_confirmation', 'unassigned', 'pending'], true)) {
            $commission->status = $debtor ? 'pending' : 'unassigned';
        }
        $commission->save();

        if ($debtor && $amount > 0) {
            $this->ledger->accrueCommission($order, $commission, $debtor);
        }

        return $commission->refresh();
    }

    public function attemptTransfer(CommissionTransfer $commission, ?string $pin = null): CommissionTransfer
    {
        if ((float) $commission->amount_usd <= 0) return $commission;
        if (! in_array($commission->status, ['pending', 'partially_paid'], true)) return $commission;

        $commission->update(['status' => 'processing', 'failure_reason' => null]);

        try {
            $response = $this->shamCash->transfer($commission->loadMissing('order'), $pin);
            $transactionId = data_get($response, 'data.tran_id');
            $commission->update([
                'status' => 'paid',
                'provider_transaction_id' => $transactionId ? (string) $transactionId : null,
                'transferred_at' => now(),
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            $commission->update(['status' => 'pending', 'failure_reason' => $error->getMessage()]);
        }

        return $commission->refresh();
    }

    public function reverseForReturnedOrder(Order $order, string $reason = 'Order returned'): ?CommissionTransfer
    {
        $commission = $order->commission()->first();
        if (! $commission) return null;
        if (in_array($commission->status, ['excluded', 'deferred', 'reversed'], true)) return $commission;

        // Keep the original debit immutable. Reversal is a new positive ledger entry.
        $this->ledger->reverseCommission($commission, $reason);

        $commission->update([
            'status' => 'reversed',
            'reversed_at' => now(),
            'reversal_reason' => $reason,
        ]);

        return $commission->refresh();
    }

    private function resolveDebtor(Order $order): ?User
    {
        // New orders record the exact account that accepted the order.
        if ($order->accepted_by_user_id) {
            $actor = $order->acceptedBy;
            return $actor?->role === 'admin' ? $actor : null;
        }

        // Backward compatibility for orders accepted before accepted_by_user_id existed.
        $event = $order->events
            ->where('event', 'order_accepted')
            ->sortByDesc('id')
            ->first();

        if ($event) {
            return $event->actor?->role === 'admin' ? $event->actor : null;
        }

        return User::query()
            ->where('role', 'admin')
            ->where('account_status', 'active')
            ->where('is_primary_admin', true)
            ->first()
            ?? User::query()
                ->where('role', 'admin')
                ->where('account_status', 'active')
                ->oldest('id')
                ->first();
    }
}


===== FILE: \app\Services\ExchangeRateService.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use RuntimeException;

class ExchangeRateService
{
    public function current(): array
    {
        $minutes = max(1, (int) config('ohmybaby.exchange.cache_minutes', 5));

        return Cache::remember('omb.exchange.usd_syp.current', now()->addMinutes($minutes), function () {
            try {
                $rate = $this->fetchFromProvider();
                Cache::put('omb.exchange.usd_syp.last_good', $rate, now()->addHours(max(1, (int) config('ohmybaby.exchange.stale_hours', 24))));
                return $rate;
            } catch (\Throwable $error) {
                $stale = Cache::get('omb.exchange.usd_syp.last_good');
                if (is_array($stale) && isset($stale['usd_to_syp'])) {
                    return [...$stale, 'stale' => true, 'warning' => 'Live exchange source unavailable; using the latest cached rate.'];
                }

                $fallback = config('ohmybaby.exchange.fallback_rate');
                if (is_numeric($fallback) && (float) $fallback > 0) {
                    return [
                        'usd_to_syp' => (float) $fallback,
                        'source' => 'configured-fallback',
                        'fetched_at' => now()->toIso8601String(),
                        'stale' => true,
                        'warning' => 'Using configured emergency fallback rate.',
                    ];
                }

                throw $error;
            }
        });
    }

    public function convertUsdToSyp(float $usd, ?array $snapshot = null): float
    {
        $snapshot ??= $this->current();
        $amount = $usd * (float) $snapshot['usd_to_syp'];
        $roundTo = max(0.01, (float) config('ohmybaby.exchange.round_to', 0.5));

        return round($amount / $roundTo) * $roundTo;
    }

    private function fetchFromProvider(): array
    {
        $jsonUrl = (string) config('ohmybaby.exchange.url');
        if ($jsonUrl !== '') {
            try {
                $response = Http::timeout(7)->retry(2, 250)->withHeaders(['User-Agent' => 'OH-MY-BABY/1.0'])->get($jsonUrl);
                $response->throw();
                $payload = $response->json();
                if (is_array($payload)) {
                    $raw = $this->extractUsdRate($payload);
                    if ($raw && $raw > 0) {
                        $divisor = max(1, (float) config('ohmybaby.exchange.source_divisor', 1));
                        return $this->snapshot($raw / $divisor, 'sp_today_json');
                    }
                }
            } catch (\Throwable) {
                // Continue to the official public currency page fallback below.
            }
        }

        $htmlUrl = (string) config('ohmybaby.exchange.html_fallback_url');
        if ($htmlUrl !== '') {
            $response = Http::timeout(7)->retry(2, 250)->withHeaders([
                'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 OH-MY-BABY/1.0',
                'Accept-Language' => 'en-US,en;q=0.9',
            ])->get($htmlUrl);
            $response->throw();
            $rate = $this->extractNewSypRateFromHtml($response->body());
            if ($rate && $rate > 0) return $this->snapshot($rate, 'sp_today_public_page');
        }

        throw new RuntimeException('USD/SYP rate was not found in SP Today sources.');
    }

    private function snapshot(float $rate, string $source): array
    {
        return [
            'usd_to_syp' => round($rate, 4),
            'source' => $source,
            'fetched_at' => now()->toIso8601String(),
            'stale' => false,
        ];
    }

    private function extractNewSypRateFromHtml(string $html): ?float
    {
        $plain = html_entity_decode(strip_tags($html), ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
        $plain = preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $plain ?? '');

        // Prefer the SELL value because that is the safer retail conversion side.
        $patterns = [
            '/Sell\s+([0-9][0-9,.]*)\s*SYP\s*\(new\)/iu',
            '/USD.{0,140}?Sell.{0,40}?([0-9][0-9,.]*)\s*SYP/iu',
            '/دولار.{0,140}?مبيع.{0,40}?([0-9][0-9,.]*)/u',
        ];
        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
            if (preg_match($pattern, $plain, $matches)) {
                $value = $this->toFloat($matches[1] ?? null);
                if ($value && $value > 0) return $value;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function extractUsdRate(array $payload): ?float
    {
        $side = strtolower((string) config('ohmybaby.exchange.side', 'sell'));
        $preferred = $side === 'buy'
            ? ['buy', 'bid', 'purchase', 'buy_price', 'price_buy']
            : ['sell', 'ask', 'sale', 'sell_price', 'price_sell'];
        $fallbackKeys = ['price', 'rate', 'value'];

        foreach ($this->arrayNodes($payload) as $node) {
            $haystack = strtolower(json_encode($node, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?: '');
            $looksUsd = str_contains($haystack, 'usd') || str_contains($haystack, 'دولار') || str_contains($haystack, 'أمريكي') || str_contains($haystack, 'امريكي');
            if (! $looksUsd) continue;

            foreach ([...$preferred, ...$fallbackKeys] as $key) {
                if (array_key_exists($key, $node)) {
                    $number = $this->toFloat($node[$key]);
                    if ($number !== null && $number > 0) return $number;
                }
            }

            foreach ($node as $key => $value) {
                $keyText = strtolower((string) $key);
                if (in_array($keyText, $preferred, true) || str_contains($keyText, $side)) {
                    $number = $this->toFloat($value);
                    if ($number !== null && $number > 0) return $number;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function arrayNodes(array $payload): array
    {
        $nodes = [$payload];
        foreach ($payload as $value) {
            if (is_array($value)) $nodes = [...$nodes, ...$this->arrayNodes($value)];
        }
        return $nodes;
    }

    private function toFloat(mixed $value): ?float
    {
        if (is_int($value) || is_float($value)) return (float) $value;
        if (! is_string($value)) return null;
        $normalized = str_replace([',', ' '], '', $value);
        $normalized = preg_replace('/[^0-9.\-]/u', '', $normalized ?? '');
        return is_numeric($normalized) ? (float) $normalized : null;
    }
}


===== FILE: \app\Services\FinancialLedgerService.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\CommissionTransfer;
use App\Models\FinancialLedgerEntry;
use App\Models\FinancialSettlement;
use App\Models\FinancialSettlementItem;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class FinancialLedgerService
{
    public function balanceFor(User|int $account): float
    {
        $id = $account instanceof User ? $account->id : $account;
        return round((float) FinancialLedgerEntry::where('account_user_id', $id)->sum('amount_usd'), 2);
    }

    public function dueFor(User|int $account): float
    {
        return round(max(0, -$this->balanceFor($account)), 2);
    }

    public function accrueCommission(Order $order, CommissionTransfer $commission, User $debtor): FinancialLedgerEntry
    {
        return FinancialLedgerEntry::firstOrCreate(
            ['idempotency_key' => 'commission:'.$commission->id],
            [
                'account_user_id' => $debtor->id,
                'order_id' => $order->id,
                'commission_transfer_id' => $commission->id,
                'type' => 'commission',
                'amount_usd' => -abs((float) $commission->amount_usd),
                'description' => 'Commission for order '.$order->reference,
                'meta' => ['commission_type' => $commission->type],
            ],
        );
    }

    public function reverseCommission(CommissionTransfer $commission, string $reason): ?FinancialLedgerEntry
    {
        $charge = FinancialLedgerEntry::query()
            ->where('commission_transfer_id', $commission->id)
            ->where('type', 'commission')
            ->first();

        if (! $charge) return null;

        return FinancialLedgerEntry::firstOrCreate(
            ['idempotency_key' => 'commission-reversal:'.$commission->id],
            [
                'account_user_id' => $charge->account_user_id,
                'order_id' => $charge->order_id,
                'commission_transfer_id' => $commission->id,
                'type' => 'commission_reversal',
                'amount_usd' => abs((float) $charge->amount_usd),
                'description' => 'Commission reversal',
                'meta' => ['reason' => $reason],
            ],
        );
    }

    public function recordSettlement(
        User $account,
        User $actor,
        float $amountUsd,
        ?string $providerTransactionId = null,
        ?string $note = null
    ): FinancialSettlement {
        if ($account->role !== 'admin') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['account' => ['التسوية المالية متاحة لحسابات Admin فقط حالياً.']]);
        }

        $amountUsd = round($amountUsd, 2);
        if ($amountUsd <= 0) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['amount_usd' => ['قيمة التسديد يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر.']]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($account, $actor, $amountUsd, $providerTransactionId, $note) {
            User::whereKey($account->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            $due = $this->dueFor($account->id);
            if ($due <= 0) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['amount_usd' => ['لا يوجد مبلغ مستحق على هذا الحساب حالياً.']]);
            }
            if ($amountUsd > $due + 0.001) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'amount_usd' => ['قيمة التسديد أكبر من المستحق الحالي وهو $'.number_format($due, 2).'.'],
                ]);
            }

            $settlement = FinancialSettlement::create([
                'account_user_id' => $account->id,
                'confirmed_by_user_id' => $actor->id,
                'amount_usd' => $amountUsd,
                'currency' => 'USD',
                'amount_currency' => $amountUsd,
                'provider' => 'manual',
                'provider_transaction_id' => $providerTransactionId ?: null,
                'status' => 'confirmed',
                'note' => $note ?: null,
                'confirmed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            FinancialLedgerEntry::create([
                'account_user_id' => $account->id,
                'settlement_id' => $settlement->id,
                'created_by_user_id' => $actor->id,
                'type' => 'settlement',
                'amount_usd' => $amountUsd,
                'idempotency_key' => 'settlement:'.$settlement->id,
                'description' => 'Confirmed commission settlement',
                'meta' => ['provider_transaction_id' => $providerTransactionId],
            ]);

            $remaining = $amountUsd;
            $ordersCount = 0;

            $charges = FinancialLedgerEntry::query()
                ->with('commission')
                ->where('account_user_id', $account->id)
                ->where('type', 'commission')
                ->where('amount_usd', '<', 0)
                ->oldest('id')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->get();

            foreach ($charges as $charge) {
                if ($remaining <= 0.0001) break;
                if (in_array($charge->commission?->status, ['reversed', 'excluded', 'deferred'], true)) continue;

                $alreadyAllocated = (float) FinancialSettlementItem::where('ledger_entry_id', $charge->id)->sum('amount_usd');
                $open = max(0, abs((float) $charge->amount_usd) - $alreadyAllocated);
                if ($open <= 0.0001) continue;

                $allocation = round(min($open, $remaining), 2);
                FinancialSettlementItem::create([
                    'settlement_id' => $settlement->id,
                    'ledger_entry_id' => $charge->id,
                    'amount_usd' => $allocation,
                ]);

                $ordersCount++;
                $remaining = round($remaining - $allocation, 2);

                if ($charge->commission) {
                    $newAllocated = $alreadyAllocated + $allocation;
                    $charge->commission->update([
                        'status' => $newAllocated + 0.001 >= abs((float) $charge->amount_usd) ? 'paid' : 'partially_paid',
                        'transferred_at' => $newAllocated + 0.001 >= abs((float) $charge->amount_usd) ? now() : null,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $settlement->update(['orders_count' => $ordersCount]);

            return $settlement->fresh(['account:id,name,email,phone', 'confirmedBy:id,name', 'items.ledgerEntry.order:id,reference']);
        });
    }
}


===== FILE: \app\Services\RewardService.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\RewardCoupon;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class RewardService
{
    public function syncForUser(User $user): array
    {
        $deliveredCount = $user->orders()
            ->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('status', 'delivered')
                    ->orWhere(function ($returnQuery) {
                        $returnQuery->whereIn('status', ['return_requested', 'return_approved', 'return_assigned', 'return_in_transit'])
                            ->whereNotNull('delivered_at');
                    });
            })
            ->count();
        $tiers = collect(config('ohmybaby.rewards.tiers', []))
            ->mapWithKeys(fn ($discount, $orders) => [(int) $orders => (float) $discount])
            ->sortKeys();

        // If a delivered order is later returned, unused coupons that are no longer earned are revoked.
        $user->rewardCoupons()
            ->where('status', 'available')
            ->where('unlock_orders', '>', $deliveredCount)
            ->update(['status' => 'revoked']);

        // If the customer earns the threshold again later, restore the unused coupon.
        $user->rewardCoupons()
            ->where('status', 'revoked')
            ->where('unlock_orders', '<=', $deliveredCount)
            ->update(['status' => 'available']);

        foreach ($tiers as $threshold => $discount) {
            if ($deliveredCount < $threshold) continue;

            RewardCoupon::firstOrCreate(
                ['user_id' => $user->id, 'unlock_orders' => $threshold],
                [
                    'code' => $this->makeCode($user, $threshold),
                    'discount_percent' => $discount,
                    'status' => 'available',
                ],
            );
        }

        $next = $tiers->keys()->first(fn ($threshold) => $threshold > $deliveredCount);

        return [
            'delivered_orders' => $deliveredCount,
            'next_threshold' => $next,
            'remaining_to_next' => $next ? max(0, $next - $deliveredCount) : 0,
            'coupons' => $user->rewardCoupons()->latest()->get(),
        ];
    }

    private function makeCode(User $user, int $threshold): string
    {
        return sprintf('OMB%d-%d-%s', $threshold, $user->id, strtoupper(Str::random(5)));
    }
}


===== FILE: \app\Services\ShamCashService.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\CommissionTransfer;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use RuntimeException;

class ShamCashService
{
    public function configured(): bool
    {
        return (bool) config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.enabled')
            && filled(config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.api_key'))
            && filled(config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.company_account'))
            && filled(config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.commission_recipient'));
    }

    public function transfer(CommissionTransfer $commission, ?string $pin = null): array
    {
        if (! $this->configured()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Sham Cash transfer is not configured.');
        }

        $query = http_build_query([
            'resource' => 'shamcash',
            'action' => 'transfer',
            'account_address' => config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.company_account'),
        ]);

        $body = [
            'to_address' => config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.commission_recipient'),
            'amount' => number_format((float) $commission->amount_usd, 2, '.', ''),
            'currency' => 'USD',
            'note' => "OH MY BABY commission {$commission->order->reference}",
        ];
        if (filled($pin)) $body['pin'] = $pin;

        $response = Http::acceptJson()
            ->withHeaders(['X-Api-Key' => config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.api_key')])
            ->timeout(12)
            ->post(rtrim((string) config('ohmybaby.sham_cash.base_url'), '/').'?'.$query, $body);

        $data = $response->json() ?: [];
        if (! $response->successful() || ! ($data['success'] ?? false)) {
            throw new RuntimeException($data['error'] ?? $data['message'] ?? 'Sham Cash transfer failed.');
        }

        return $data;
    }
}


===== FILE: \app\Support\DataScope.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\CatalogProduct;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class DataScope
{
    public const MODE_ALL = 'all';
    public const MODE_SECTION = 'section';
    public const MODE_ASSIGNED = 'assigned';
    public const MODE_RELATED = 'related';

    public static function definitionsForRole(string $role): array
    {
        if ($role === 'delivery') {
            return [
                'orders' => [
                    'ar' => 'الطلبات', 'en' => 'Orders',
                    'modes' => [self::MODE_ASSIGNED, self::MODE_ALL],
                    'default' => self::MODE_ASSIGNED,
                ],
                'customers' => [
                    'ar' => 'بيانات الزباين', 'en' => 'Customer data',
                    'modes' => [self::MODE_RELATED],
                    'default' => self::MODE_RELATED,
                ],
            ];
        }

        if ($role !== 'admin') {
            return [];
        }

        return [
            'orders' => [
                'ar' => 'الطلبات', 'en' => 'Orders',
                'modes' => [self::MODE_ALL, self::MODE_SECTION],
                'default' => self::MODE_ALL,
            ],
            'products' => [
                'ar' => 'المنتجات والمخزون', 'en' => 'Products & inventory',
                'modes' => [self::MODE_ALL, self::MODE_SECTION],
                'default' => self::MODE_ALL,
            ],
            'customers' => [
                'ar' => 'بيانات الزباين', 'en' => 'Customer data',
                'modes' => [self::MODE_ALL, self::MODE_RELATED],
                'default' => self::MODE_ALL,
            ],
            'delivery' => [
                'ar' => 'بيانات التوصيل', 'en' => 'Delivery data',
                'modes' => [self::MODE_ALL, self::MODE_ASSIGNED],
                'default' => self::MODE_ALL,
            ],
        ];
    }

    public static function modeLabels(): array
    {
        return [
            self::MODE_ALL => ['ar' => 'كل البيانات', 'en' => 'All data'],
            self::MODE_SECTION => ['ar' => 'قسم محدد', 'en' => 'Specific section'],
            self::MODE_ASSIGNED => ['ar' => 'المسند للحساب فقط', 'en' => 'Assigned to this account only'],
            self::MODE_RELATED => ['ar' => 'البيانات المرتبطة بما يشوفه فقط', 'en' => 'Only data related to visible records'],
        ];
    }

    public static function sectionOptions(): array
    {
        $labels = [
            'newborn' => ['ar' => 'حديثي الولادة', 'en' => 'Newborn'],
            'girls' => ['ar' => 'بنات', 'en' => 'Girls'],
            'boys' => ['ar' => 'أولاد', 'en' => 'Boys'],
            'shoes' => ['ar' => 'أحذية', 'en' => 'Shoes'],
            'accessories' => ['ar' => 'إكسسوارات', 'en' => 'Accessories'],
            'decor' => ['ar' => 'استقبال المولود والتزيين', 'en' => 'Newborn Welcome & Decor'],
            'mobility' => ['ar' => 'عربايات ومقاعد', 'en' => 'Strollers & Seats'],
            'gifts' => ['ar' => 'هدايا', 'en' => 'Gifts'],
            'baby-essentials' => ['ar' => 'ألعاب ومستلزمات الطفل', 'en' => 'Toys & Essentials'],
        ];

        try {
            $existing = CatalogProduct::query()
                ->whereNotNull('category')
                ->distinct()
                ->orderBy('category')
                ->pluck('category')
                ->filter()
                ->values();

            foreach ($existing as $code) {
                if (! isset($labels[$code])) {
                    $labels[$code] = ['ar' => $code, 'en' => $code];
                }
            }
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            // Migrations may not have created catalog_products yet in a fresh install.
        }

        return collect($labels)->map(fn (array $label, string $code) => [
            'code' => $code,
            'ar' => $label['ar'],
            'en' => $label['en'],
        ])->values()->all();
    }

    public static function defaultsForRole(string $role): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach (self::definitionsForRole($role) as $domain => $definition) {
            $result[$domain] = [
                'mode' => $definition['default'],
                'values' => [],
            ];
        }
        return $result;
    }

    public static function effectiveFor(User $user): array
    {
        if ($user->role === 'owner') {
            return [
                'orders' => ['mode' => self::MODE_ALL, 'values' => []],
                'products' => ['mode' => self::MODE_ALL, 'values' => []],
                'customers' => ['mode' => self::MODE_ALL, 'values' => []],
                'delivery' => ['mode' => self::MODE_ALL, 'values' => []],
            ];
        }

        return self::normalizeForRole($user->role, is_array($user->data_scopes) ? $user->data_scopes : []);
    }

    public static function normalizeForRole(string $role, array $raw): array
    {
        $definitions = self::definitionsForRole($role);
        $defaults = self::defaultsForRole($role);
        $normalized = [];

        foreach ($definitions as $domain => $definition) {
            $candidate = is_array($raw[$domain] ?? null) ? $raw[$domain] : [];
            $mode = (string) ($candidate['mode'] ?? $defaults[$domain]['mode']);
            if (! in_array($mode, $definition['modes'], true)) {
                $mode = $defaults[$domain]['mode'];
            }

            $values = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(
                is_array($candidate['values'] ?? null) ? $candidate['values'] : [],
                fn ($value) => is_string($value) && trim($value) !== ''
            )));

            if ($mode !== self::MODE_SECTION) {
                $values = [];
            }

            $normalized[$domain] = ['mode' => $mode, 'values' => $values];
        }

        return $normalized;
    }

    public static function validateAssignment(User $actor, string $targetRole, array $requested, array $targetPermissions = []): array
    {
        $target = self::normalizeForRole($targetRole, $requested);
        if ($actor->role === 'owner') {
            self::validateSectionSelections($target);
            return $target;
        }

        if ($actor->role !== 'admin') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'data_scopes' => ['This account cannot delegate data access.'],
            ]);
        }

        $actorScopes = self::effectiveFor($actor);
        $relevantDomains = self::relevantDomainsForPermissions($targetRole, $targetPermissions);
        if (count($relevantDomains) === 0) {
            self::validateSectionSelections($target);
            return $target;
        }
        foreach ($target as $domain => $scope) {
            if ($relevantDomains && ! in_array($domain, $relevantDomains, true)) continue;
            $actorScope = $actorScopes[$domain] ?? null;
            if (! $actorScope || ! self::scopeWithin($scope, $actorScope)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    "data_scopes.$domain" => ['The selected data scope is broader than the creator account.'],
                ]);
            }
        }

        self::validateSectionSelections($target);
        return $target;
    }

    public static function canManageTarget(User $actor, User $target): bool
    {
        if ($actor->role === 'owner') return true;
        if ($actor->role !== 'admin') return false;

        $actorScopes = self::effectiveFor($actor);
        $targetScopes = self::effectiveFor($target);
        $relevantDomains = self::relevantDomainsForPermissions($target->role, PermissionCatalog::effectiveFor($target));
        if (count($relevantDomains) === 0) return true;

        foreach ($targetScopes as $domain => $scope) {
            if ($relevantDomains && ! in_array($domain, $relevantDomains, true)) continue;
            if (! isset($actorScopes[$domain]) || ! self::scopeWithin($scope, $actorScopes[$domain])) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function scopeWithin(array $child, array $parent): bool
    {
        $childMode = $child['mode'] ?? null;
        $parentMode = $parent['mode'] ?? null;

        if ($parentMode === self::MODE_ALL) return true;
        if ($childMode !== $parentMode) return false;

        if ($parentMode === self::MODE_SECTION) {
            $parentValues = $parent['values'] ?? [];
            $childValues = $child['values'] ?? [];
            return count(array_diff($childValues, $parentValues)) === 0;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function applyOrders(Builder $query, User $user): Builder
    {
        $scope = self::effectiveFor($user)['orders'] ?? ['mode' => self::MODE_ALL, 'values' => []];

        return match ($scope['mode']) {
            self::MODE_ALL => $query,
            self::MODE_ASSIGNED => $query->where(function (Builder $q) use ($user) {
                $q->where('assigned_delivery_id', $user->id)
                    ->orWhere('return_delivery_id', $user->id);
            }),
            self::MODE_SECTION => $query->whereHas('items', fn (Builder $q) => $q->whereIn('category', $scope['values'] ?: ['__none__'])),
            self::MODE_RELATED => $query->where('user_id', $user->id),
            default => $query->whereRaw('1 = 0'),
        };
    }

    public static function applyProducts(Builder $query, User $user): Builder
    {
        $scope = self::effectiveFor($user)['products'] ?? ['mode' => self::MODE_ALL, 'values' => []];

        return match ($scope['mode']) {
            self::MODE_ALL => $query,
            self::MODE_SECTION => $query->whereIn('category', $scope['values'] ?: ['__none__']),
            default => $query->whereRaw('1 = 0'),
        };
    }

    public static function applyDeliveryOrders(Builder $query, User $user): Builder
    {
        if ($user->role === 'delivery') {
            return self::applyOrders($query, $user);
        }

        $scope = self::effectiveFor($user)['delivery'] ?? ['mode' => self::MODE_ALL, 'values' => []];
        return match ($scope['mode']) {
            self::MODE_ALL => $query,
            self::MODE_ASSIGNED => $query->where(function (Builder $q) use ($user) {
                $q->where('assigned_delivery_id', $user->id)
                    ->orWhere('return_delivery_id', $user->id);
            }),
            default => $query->whereRaw('1 = 0'),
        };
    }

    public static function assertOrderVisible(User $user, Order $order): void
    {
        $visible = self::applyOrders(Order::query()->whereKey($order->id), $user)->exists();
        abort_unless($visible, 403);
    }

    public static function assertDeliveryOrderVisible(User $user, Order $order): void
    {
        $visible = self::applyDeliveryOrders(Order::query()->whereKey($order->id), $user)->exists();
        abort_unless($visible, 403);
    }

    public static function assertProductCategoryVisible(User $user, string $category): void
    {
        if ($user->role === 'owner') return;

        $scope = self::effectiveFor($user)['products'] ?? null;
        if (! $scope) abort(403);
        if ($scope['mode'] === self::MODE_ALL) return;

        abort_unless(
            $scope['mode'] === self::MODE_SECTION && in_array($category, $scope['values'] ?? [], true),
            403
        );
    }

    public static function relevantDomainsForPermissions(string $role, array $permissions): array
    {
        if ($role === 'delivery') {
            return array_values(array_filter(['orders', 'customers'], fn ($domain) => match ($domain) {
                'orders' => self::hasPrefix($permissions, 'delivery.'),
                'customers' => in_array('delivery.customer_phone', $permissions, true),
                default => false,
            }));
        }

        if ($role !== 'admin') return [];

        $domains = [];
        if (self::hasPrefix($permissions, 'orders.')) $domains[] = 'orders';
        if (self::hasPrefix($permissions, 'products.')) $domains[] = 'products';
        if (self::hasPrefix($permissions, 'delivery.')) $domains[] = 'delivery';
        return $domains;
    }

    private static function hasPrefix(array $permissions, string $prefix): bool
    {
        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            if (str_starts_with($permission, $prefix)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static function validateSectionSelections(array $scopes): void
    {
        $allowedSections = array_column(self::sectionOptions(), 'code');
        foreach ($scopes as $domain => $scope) {
            if (($scope['mode'] ?? null) !== self::MODE_SECTION) continue;
            if (empty($scope['values'])) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    "data_scopes.$domain.values" => ['Choose at least one section for a section-limited scope.'],
                ]);
            }
            if (array_diff($scope['values'], $allowedSections)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    "data_scopes.$domain.values" => ['One or more selected sections are invalid.'],
                ]);
            }
        }
    }
}

    public static function flatForRole(string $role): array
    {
        $codes = [];
        foreach (self::groupsForRole($role) as $group) {
            foreach ($group['items'] as $item) {
                $codes[] = $item['code'];
            }
        }
        return array_values(array_unique($codes));
    }

    public static function dependencies(): array
    {
        return [
            'team.create_admin' => ['team.view'],
            'team.create_delivery' => ['team.view'],
            'team.create_customer' => ['team.view'],
            'team.edit_accounts' => ['team.view'],
            'team.manage_permissions' => ['team.view'],
            'team.suspend_accounts' => ['team.view'],
            'products.create' => ['products.view'],
            'products.edit' => ['products.view'],
            'products.archive' => ['products.view'],
            'orders.accept' => ['orders.view'],
            'orders.reject' => ['orders.view'],
            'orders.dispatch' => ['orders.view'],
            'orders.returns' => ['orders.view'],
            'delivery.act_as' => ['delivery.view'],
            'finance.transfer' => ['finance.view'],
            'marketing.manage' => ['marketing.view'],
            'support.reply' => ['support.view'],
            'support.assign' => ['support.view'],
            'support.close' => ['support.view'],
            'delivery.start' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
            'delivery.complete' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
            'delivery.return_at_door' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
            'delivery.return_pickup' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
            'delivery.return_complete' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
            'delivery.customer_phone' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
        ];
    }

    public static function effectiveFor(User $user): array
    {
        if ($user->role === 'owner') {
            return ['*'];
        }

        $allowed = self::flatForRole($user->role);
        $assigned = is_array($user->permissions) ? $user->permissions : [];

        return array_values(array_intersect($assigned, $allowed));
    }

    public static function has(User $user, string $permission): bool
    {
        if ($user->role === 'owner') {
            return true;
        }

        return in_array($permission, self::effectiveFor($user), true);
    }

    public static function assignableBy(User $actor, string $targetRole): array
    {
        $targetAllowed = self::flatForRole($targetRole);
        if ($actor->role === 'owner') {
            return $targetAllowed;
        }

        if ($actor->role !== 'admin') {
            return [];
        }

        $actorEffective = self::effectiveFor($actor);
        return array_values(array_intersect($targetAllowed, $actorEffective));
    }

    public static function targetPermissionsWithinActor(User $actor, User $target): bool
    {
        if ($actor->role === 'owner') return true;
        if ($actor->role !== 'admin') return false;

        return count(array_diff(self::effectiveFor($target), self::effectiveFor($actor))) === 0;
    }

    public static function sanitizeForAssignment(User $actor, string $targetRole, array $requested): array
    {
        $assignable = self::assignableBy($actor, $targetRole);
        $selected = array_values(array_intersect(array_values(array_unique($requested)), $assignable));
        $dependencies = self::dependencies();

        $changed = true;
        while ($changed) {
            $changed = false;
            foreach ($selected as $permission) {
                foreach ($dependencies[$permission] ?? [] as $dependency) {
                    if (in_array($dependency, $assignable, true) && ! in_array($dependency, $selected, true)) {
                        $selected[] = $dependency;
                        $changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return array_values(array_unique($selected));
    }
}

<?php

use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Http\Middleware\EnsureRole;
use App\Http\Middleware\EnsurePermission;
use App\Http\Middleware\EnsureAccountActive;
use App\Http\Middleware\EnsureStaffWorkspace;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        $middleware->alias([
            'role' => EnsureRole::class,
            'permission' => EnsurePermission::class,
            'active' => EnsureAccountActive::class,
            'staff.workspace' => EnsureStaffWorkspace::class,
        ]);
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        $exceptions->shouldRenderJsonWhen(
            fn (Request $request) => $request->is('api/*') || $request->expectsJson(),
        );
    })->create();

===== FILE: \config\auth.php =====
<?php

use App\Models\User;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Defaults
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option defines the default authentication "guard" and password
    | reset "broker" for your application. You may change these values
    | as required, but they're a perfect start for most applications.
    |
    */

    'defaults' => [
        'guard' => env('AUTH_GUARD', 'web'),
        'passwords' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_BROKER', 'users'),
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Guards
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Next, you may define every authentication guard for your application.
    | Of course, a great default configuration has been defined for you
    | which utilizes session storage plus the Eloquent user provider.
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | Supported: "session"
    |
    */

    'guards' => [
        'web' => [
            'driver' => 'session',
            'provider' => 'users',
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | User Providers
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | If you have multiple user tables or models you may configure multiple
    | providers to represent the model / table. These providers may then
    | be assigned to any extra authentication guards you have defined.
    |
    | Supported: "database", "eloquent"
    |
    */

    'providers' => [
        'users' => [
            'driver' => 'eloquent',
            'model' => env('AUTH_MODEL', User::class),
        ],

        // 'users' => [
        //     'driver' => 'database',
        //     'table' => 'users',
        // ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Resetting Passwords
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | These configuration options specify the behavior of Laravel's password
    | reset functionality, including the table utilized for token storage
    | and the user provider that is invoked to actually retrieve users.
    |
    | The expiry time is the number of minutes that each reset token will be
    | considered valid. This security feature keeps tokens short-lived so
    | they have less time to be guessed. You may change this as needed.
    |
    | The throttle setting is the number of seconds a user must wait before
    | generating more password reset tokens. This prevents the user from
    | quickly generating a very large amount of password reset tokens.
    |
    */

    'passwords' => [
        'users' => [
            'provider' => 'users',
            'table' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TABLE', 'password_reset_tokens'),
            'expire' => 60,
            'throttle' => 60,
        ],
    ],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Password Confirmation Timeout
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define the number of seconds before a password confirmation
    | window expires and users are asked to re-enter their password via the
    | confirmation screen. By default, the timeout lasts for three hours.
    |
    */

    'password_timeout' => env('AUTH_PASSWORD_TIMEOUT', 10800),

];

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

return [

    |
    */

    'default' => env('CACHE_STORE', 'database'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Cache Stores
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may define all of the cache "stores" for your application as
    | well as their drivers. You may even define multiple stores for the
    | same cache driver to group types of items stored in your caches.
    |
    | Supported drivers: "array", "database", "file", "memcached",
    |                    "redis", "dynamodb", "storage", "octane",
    |                    "session", "failover", "null"
    |
    */

        'array' => [
            'driver' => 'array',
            'serialize' => false,
        ],

            'driver' => 'database',
            'connection' => env('DB_CACHE_CONNECTION'),
            'table' => env('DB_CACHE_TABLE', 'cache'),
            'lock_connection' => env('DB_CACHE_LOCK_CONNECTION'),
            'lock_table' => env('DB_CACHE_LOCK_TABLE'),
        ],

        'file' => [
            'driver' => 'file',
            'path' => storage_path('framework/cache/data'),
            'lock_path' => storage_path('framework/cache/data'),
        ],

        'storage' => [
            'driver' => 'storage',
            'disk' => env('CACHE_STORAGE_DISK'),
            'path' => env('CACHE_STORAGE_PATH', 'framework/cache/data'),
        ],

        'memcached' => [

            'persistent_id' => env('MEMCACHED_PERSISTENT_ID'),
            'sasl' => [
                env('MEMCACHED_USERNAME'),
                env('MEMCACHED_PASSWORD'),

                // Memcached::OPT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT => 2000,
            ],

                    'weight' => 100,
                ],
            ],
        ],

        'redis' => [
            'driver' => 'redis',
            'connection' => env('REDIS_CACHE_CONNECTION', 'cache'),

                'database',
                'array',
            ],
        ],

    /*

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    'serializable_classes' => false,

===== FILE: \database\factories\UserFactory.php =====
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

===== FILE: \database\migrations\2026_09_16_000008_add_permissions_to_users.php =====
<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->json('permissions')->nullable()->after('is_primary_admin');
            $table->timestamp('permissions_updated_at')->nullable()->after('permissions');
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('permissions_updated_by')->nullable()->after('permissions_updated_at')->index();
        });

        // Existing delivery accounts were created before granular permissions
        // existed. Keep them operational after this migration; new accounts are
        // configured explicitly from the Accounts & Team screen.
        $deliveryPermissions = [
            'delivery.orders.view',
            'delivery.start',
            'delivery.complete',
            'delivery.return_at_door',
            'delivery.return_pickup',
            'delivery.return_complete',
            'delivery.customer_phone',
        ];

        DB::table('users')
            ->where('role', 'delivery')
            ->whereNull('permissions')
            ->update([
                'permissions' => json_encode($deliveryPermissions, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
                'permissions_updated_at' => now(),
            ]);

        // Secondary Admins intentionally start with no delegated permissions.
        // The primary Admin/Owner can grant exactly what each one needs.
        DB::table('users')
            ->where('role', 'admin')
            ->where('is_primary_admin', false)
            ->whereNull('permissions')
            ->update([
                'permissions' => json_encode([]),
                'permissions_updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->dropIndex(['permissions_updated_by']);
            $table->dropColumn(['permissions', 'permissions_updated_at', 'permissions_updated_by']);
        });
    }
};

===== FILE: \database\migrations\2026_09_27_000001_normalize_and_unique_user_phones.php =====
<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable('users') || ! Schema::hasColumn('users', 'phone')) {
            return;
        }

        $rows = DB::table('users')
            ->whereNotNull('phone')
            ->where('phone', '!=', '')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get(['id', 'phone']);

        $normalizedById = [];
        $owners = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $normalized = str_replace([' ', '-', '(', ')'], '', trim((string) $row->phone));
            if ($normalized === '') {
                continue;
            }

            if (isset($owners[$normalized])) {
                throw new \RuntimeException(
                    'Cannot add a unique phone constraint because users '.$owners[$normalized].' and '.$row->id.' normalize to the same phone: '.$normalized
                );
            }

            $owners[$normalized] = $row->id;
            $normalizedById[$row->id] = $normalized;
        }

        foreach ($normalizedById as $id => $normalized) {
            DB::table('users')->where('id', $id)->update(['phone' => $normalized]);
        }

        Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->unique('phone', 'users_phone_unique');
        });
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable('users') || ! Schema::hasColumn('users', 'phone')) {
            return;
        }

        Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->dropUnique('users_phone_unique');
        });
    }
};

===== FILE: \docs\ACCESS_CONTROL_AND_DATA_SCOPE.md =====
# OH MY BABY — Access Control Model

## قاعدة النظام

الـOwner هو جذر الصلاحيات. كل حساب آخر يملك فقط ما تم منحه له صراحةً.

النظام يقسم الوصول إلى طبقتين:

1. **Permissions** — ماذا يستطيع الحساب أن يفعل؟
   - مشاهدة
   - إنشاء
   - تعديل
   - أرشفة/حذف حسب الوظيفة
   - قبول/رفض/تعيين/تحويل...

2. **Data Scope** — على أي بيانات يستطيع تنفيذ هذه الصلاحية؟
   - `all`: كل بيانات القسم.
   - `section`: قسم/أقسام محددة مثل `decor`.
   - `assigned`: البيانات المسندة للحساب فقط.
   - `related`: البيانات المرتبطة بالسجلات التي يستطيع الحساب رؤيتها فقط.

## سقف التفويض Delegation Ceiling

إذا أعطى الـOwner Admin صلاحية إنشاء حسابات أخرى:

- الـAdmin لا يستطيع منح Permission لا يملكها هو.
- الـAdmin لا يستطيع منح Data Scope أوسع من نطاقه.
- الـBackend يفرض هذه القاعدة حتى لو تم تزوير الطلب من المتصفح.
- الحساب الأقوى لا يمكن إدارته من حساب أدنى منه.

مثال:

- Admin A يملك `orders.view` فقط ونطاقه `decor`.
- يستطيع إنشاء Admin B بـ `orders.view` ونطاق `decor` أو أضيق.
- لا يستطيع إعطاء B `finance.view`.
- لا يستطيع جعل B يرى كل الطلبات.

## Admin التزيين

يمكن إنشاء Admin وإعطاؤه:

- صلاحيات المنتجات/الطلبات المطلوبة فقط.
- Data Scope من نوع `section` واختيار `decor`.

عندها APIs الخاصة بالمنتجات والطلبات تطبق النطاق من السيرفر، وليس فقط من الواجهة.

## Delivery

الافتراضي لحساب Delivery:

- الطلبات: `assigned`
- بيانات الزبائن: `related`

وهذا يمنع السائق من رؤية طلبات سائق آخر إلا إذا قام الـOwner صراحةً بتوسيع نطاقه.

## التوافق مع الحسابات القديمة

إذا كان حساب قديم لا يحتوي `data_scopes`، يتم تطبيق Default آمن متوافق مع دوره حتى لا تتعطل الحسابات بعد الـmigration.

## نقاط الحماية الحالية

- Permission checks على الـBackend.
- Data Scope filters على الطلبات والمنتجات ولوحة الإحصائيات والتوصيل.
- منع تنفيذ Action على Order خارج نطاق الحساب.
- منع تعديل Product خارج نطاق الحساب.
- Audit log لإدارة الحسابات.
- Primary Admin لا يحصل على صلاحيات مخفية؛ الـOwner يحدد صلاحياته مثل أي Admin.


===== FILE: \docs\ACCOUNT_MANAGEMENT_SECURITY.md =====
# OH MY BABY — Account Management Safety Rules

This document describes the rules used by the Owner account-management screen.

## Core rule
Operational account management must happen from `/owner/team`, not from Tinker during normal use.
Tinker remains an emergency/development tool only.

## Owner capabilities
- Create Admin / Delivery / Customer accounts.
- Edit name, email, phone and delegated permissions.
- Change a password when necessary.
- Suspend / reactivate accounts.
- Assign the Primary Admin.
- Permanently delete **only an unused account with no linked business history**.

## Permanent deletion protection
Permanent deletion is intentionally blocked when an account is linked to business data such as:
- customer orders
- assigned deliveries or return deliveries
- order event history
- reward coupons
- owner requests
- catalog-product attribution
- wishlist / product reviews
- poll votes / customer feedback

If an account has business history, suspend it instead. This prevents accidental deletion of order, delivery, audit or financial context.

The Owner account cannot be deleted from the team screen.
The Primary Admin must first be reassigned before it can be suspended or permanently deleted.

## Atomic writes
Create, update, suspend, reactivate, Primary Admin reassignment and permanent deletion are wrapped in database transactions. A failed operation is rolled back instead of leaving half-applied state.

## Identity rules
- Emails are normalized to lowercase.
- Phones are normalized by removing spaces, dashes and parentheses.
- Email and phone duplication is rejected server-side.
- A database migration normalizes existing phones and adds a unique phone index. If historical duplicates exist, the migration stops with an explicit error instead of guessing which account should win.

## Sessions
Suspending an account, changing its password, or permanently deleting it invalidates database sessions for that user when the `sessions` table is in use.
A suspended account is also rejected directly by the login endpoint.

## Audit trail
Sensitive account-management actions continue to be written to `staff_action_logs`.
New log entries include a target-account snapshot so history remains understandable even if an unused account is later permanently deleted.

## Demo accounts
`DatabaseSeeder` no longer creates demo accounts.
`DemoAccountsSeeder` is permanently retired and throws if called manually.

## Test command
After applying the patch and running migrations:

```powershell
php artisan test --filter=TeamManagementSecurityTest
```

Then manually test `/owner/team` with the real Owner account before creating production staff accounts.


===== FILE: \docs\ADMIN_PERMISSION_AWARE_UI.md =====
# Admin Permission-Aware Workspace

هذا التعديل يجعل لوحة الـAdmin تتشكل من الصلاحيات الفعلية المخزنة للحساب بدل افتراض أن كل Admin يرى كل شيء.

## السلوك
- `/admin` متاح لأي Admin فعّال، لكنه يعرض فقط الأقسام المسموح بها.
- لا يتم طلب `/api/dashboard` إذا الحساب لا يملك `analytics.view`، لذلك لا يظهر خطأ 403 داخل اللوحة.
- الصفحات التشغيلية نفسها محمية من السيرفر:
  - `/admin/orders` -> `orders.view`
  - `/admin/products` -> `products.view`
  - `/admin/team` -> `team.view`
  - `/admin/operations` -> `finance.view`
  - `/admin/marketing` -> `analytics.view`
  - `/delivery` -> واحدة من صلاحيات التوصيل المناسبة.
- `/auth/session` يعيد `effective_permissions` حتى تبني الواجهة نفسها على نفس قرار الـBackend.
- بيانات Dashboard الحساسة تُقص حسب الصلاحيات: الطلبات الحديثة تحتاج `orders.view`، الفريق يحتاج `team.view`، والماليات تحتاج `finance.view`.

## مبدأ الأمان
إخفاء المربع بالواجهة ليس الحماية الأساسية. المسار والـAPI محميان أيضًا في Laravel Middleware.


===== FILE: \docs\AUTH_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_PASSWORD_RESET.md =====
# OH MY BABY — Email verification and password reset

## Email verification

Public customer registration now requires a real email address.

Flow:

1. Customer creates an account with name, phone, email and password.
2. The account is created with `email_verified_at = null`.
3. A six-digit verification code is sent to the email.
4. Code lifetime: 10 minutes.
5. Resend cooldown: 60 seconds.
6. Maximum verification attempts per code: 5.
7. A new code invalidates the previous active code.
8. After a correct code, `email_verified_at` is set.
9. Customers with a real but unverified email cannot submit an order.

Google accounts whose Google email is already verified are marked verified automatically.

Legacy phone-only customer accounts using an internal `@ohmybaby.local` address remain compatible. New public registrations cannot use this fallback because email is required.

## Password reset

1. User enters the account email.
2. The endpoint always returns a generic response so it does not reveal whether the email exists.
3. If the email exists, a six-digit reset code is sent.
4. Code lifetime: 10 minutes.
5. Resend cooldown: 60 seconds.
6. Maximum code attempts: 5.
7. On success, the password is replaced and existing database sessions are invalidated.

## Security

Codes are never stored in plaintext. `auth_codes.code_hash` stores a one-way password hash.

The backend enforces expiration, attempt limits, cooldown and purpose separation (`verify_email` vs `password_reset`).

## Mail delivery

Laravel mail configuration is read from `.env`.

For local development, `MAIL_MAILER=log` writes mail content to the Laravel log instead of sending real email.

For production, configure a real SMTP/API mail provider in `.env`. Never commit mail credentials to Git.

## Main endpoints

- `POST /auth/email-verification/send`
- `POST /auth/email-verification/verify`
- `POST /auth/password/forgot`
- `POST /auth/password/reset`

## Test

Run:

```powershell
php artisan test --filter=AuthEmailVerificationPasswordResetTest
```

# OH MY BABY — Customer Support Chat v1

## What is included

### Storefront
A floating **Contact us / تواصل معنا** button is available on customer-facing pages.

A visitor can start a conversation with:
- name
- phone
- optional order reference
- optional subject
- message

The browser stores a private conversation token locally so the visitor can return to the same thread from the same browser.

### Logged-in customer
A Customer account can:
- start support conversations without re-entering name/phone
- see its own conversation list
- receive unread reply badges
- reply to open conversations
- start a conversation linked to one of its orders
- use **استفسار عن هذا الطلب** from the customer order card

### Owner / Admin inbox
Owner: `/owner/support`

Admin with `support.view`: `/admin/support`

The inbox includes:
- open conversations
- waiting for customer
- closed conversations
- unread counts
- linked order reference
- registered customer or guest identity
- assignment to a support staff account
- reply
- close / reopen
- automatic polling every 10 seconds

## Permissions

Admin permissions are independent:

- `support.view`
- `support.reply`
- `support.assign`
- `support.close`

Dependencies:
- reply -> view
- assign -> view
- close -> view

Owner has full support access automatically.

## Security

- Staff actions are protected by backend permissions.
- A registered customer can only read/reply to conversations owned by that user ID.
- A guest can only read/reply with the 64-character private support token stored in that browser.
- Guest order linking requires both order reference and matching phone number.
- Message bodies are limited to 3000 characters.
- Public create/reply endpoints are rate limited.
- Closed conversations cannot receive new customer replies; a new conversation can be opened instead.

## Not included in v1

- file/image attachments
- WebSocket real-time transport
- email/SMS push notifications
- automatic AI replies

The UI currently refreshes conversations periodically, which is simpler and production-safe for the first version.


===== FILE: \docs\FINANCIAL_LEDGER_DEBT.md =====
# OH MY BABY — Internal commission ledger and debt balance

## Current scope

This stage builds the internal financial source of truth. Live Sham Cash transfer is intentionally deferred.

### Normal order commission

A normal eligible order creates the $0.50 debt only after both conditions are true:

1. Delivery marked the order delivered.
2. Customer confirmed receipt from the Customer dashboard.

The responsible Admin is the Admin that accepted the order. Legacy orders can fall back to Primary Admin when no acceptance actor exists.

From the Admin account perspective:

- Commission charge: negative ledger entry, e.g. `-0.50 USD`.
- Confirmed settlement/payment: positive entry.
- Valid commission reversal: positive entry.

Therefore an Admin that owes $2.00 has:

- Balance: `-2.00 USD`
- Amount due: `2.00 USD`

## Immutability

Original commission entries are never deleted when a return happens. A separate `commission_reversal` entry is created.

## Settlements

Only Owner can record a confirmed settlement in this phase.

Settlements may be partial. They are allocated FIFO to open commission charges and store:

- amount
- transaction/reference ID (optional for now)
- note
- confirmation time
- number of commission/order entries covered

This is ready to become the confirmation layer for Sham Cash later.

## Decoration

Decoration commission is deliberately marked `deferred` and does not affect the normal Admin ledger yet. The special decoration settlement flow will be built separately as requested.

## Offers

Current configured rule remains: orders containing Offers items are excluded from the normal $0.50 commission.

## Main API

- `GET /api/owner/commissions`
- `POST /api/owner/finance/accounts/{account}/settlements` — Owner only
- `POST /api/orders/{order}/confirm-receipt` — Customer who owns the order

## Test

```powershell
php artisan test --filter=FinancialLedgerDebtTest
```


===== FILE: \docs\OWNER_WORKSPACE_UI.md =====
# Owner Workspace UI — OH MY BABY

## القاعدة البصرية
- الصفحة الرئيسية للـOwner تعرض 12 قسمًا ثابتًا.
- كل بطاقة تعرض **أيقونة + اسم القسم فقط**.
- لا نعرض الوصف والحالة والأرقام داخل البطاقة حتى تبقى الواجهة نظيفة وسريعة القراءة.
- الـhover يعطي رفعًا خفيفًا، تكبيرًا للأيقونة، وتحويلها إلى لون accent بدون مبالغة.
- ترتيب البطاقات حسب أولوية عمل الـOwner، وليس حسب ترتيب تقني داخلي.

## ترتيب الأولوية الحالي
1. الحسابات والصلاحيات
2. الماليات والعمولات
3. الطلبات
4. المنتجات والمخزون
5. التوصيل
6. التزيين
7. العملاء
8. التسويق والعروض
9. التقارير والإحصائيات
10. إعدادات النظام والأمان
11. حساب المالك
12. المساعدة ودليل النظام

## قاعدة الحسابات الأخرى
نفس أسماء الأقسام تُستخدم مع Admin وDelivery والحسابات المتخصصة. الاختلاف ليس في أسماء الواجهة، بل في:
- Visibility: ما الأقسام التي تظهر.
- Actions: ما العمليات المسموحة.
- Scope: ما البيانات التي يستطيع الحساب الوصول إليها.
- Delegation: ما الذي يستطيع تفويضه أو منحه لحساب آخر.

## قاعدة إنهاء/حذف الموظف
الحساب المرتبط بمهمة تشغيلية نشطة لا يُحذف مباشرة. قبل الحذف النهائي يجب إنهاء المهمة أو إعادة إسنادها لحساب آخر، ثم يسمح النظام بالحذف فقط عندما تصبح العلاقات التشغيلية والمالية آمنة للحذف. وإلا يُستخدم الإيقاف بدل الحذف.

هذا التعديل واجهة فقط ولا يغيّر قاعدة البيانات أو الصلاحيات أو منطق الحسابات.
