===== FILE: \docs\ROLE_DASHBOARDS_AND_STOREFRONT_ACCESS.md =====
# Role dashboards and storefront access

Every role has a dedicated dashboard:

- Owner: `/owner`
- Admin: `/admin`
- Delivery: `/delivery`
- Customer: `/customer`

For Admin and Delivery accounts, the Owner can choose one of two workspace modes while creating or editing the account:

1. **Dashboard only**: the account is redirected back to its work dashboard when it tries to open public storefront pages.
2. **Dashboard + storefront**: the account can browse the public store while remaining signed in.

The `storefront_access` flag is Owner-controlled. A delegated Admin may create lower accounts when permitted, but cannot grant storefront access. Customer accounts always retain storefront access.


===== FILE: \docs\WORKSPACE_ISOLATION.md =====
# Staff workspace isolation

- Owner remains the root account and can still access the store when needed.
- Admin and Delivery accounts are work accounts, not customer browsing sessions.
- While an Admin is signed in, public storefront pages redirect to `/admin`.
- While a Delivery account is signed in, public storefront pages redirect to `/delivery`.
- Staff pages use a dedicated workspace header with Dashboard, language/theme controls and Sign out only.
- Signing out returns the browser to the public store.
- An Admin sees only workspace cards granted by permissions.
- `decoration.view` enables a dedicated `/admin/decoration` workspace, allowing an Admin account to be isolated to decoration only.
- Server-side permission middleware remains authoritative even if a URL is typed manually.


===== FILE: \js\components\SupportChatLauncher.jsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { apiFetch } from "../lib/api";

const GUEST_KEY = "omb:support-guest";

function readGuestThread() {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(GUEST_KEY) || "null");
    return parsed?.id && parsed?.token ? parsed : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function saveGuestThread(value) {
  try {
    if (value) window.localStorage.setItem(GUEST_KEY, JSON.stringify(value));
    else window.localStorage.removeItem(GUEST_KEY);
  } catch {}
}

function statusLabel(status, isAr) {
  if (status === "waiting_customer") return isAr ? "بانتظار ردك" : "Waiting for you";
  if (status === "closed") return isAr ? "مغلقة" : "Closed";
  return isAr ? "قيد المتابعة" : "Open";
}

function Message({ message, isAr }) {
  const fromStaff = message.sender_type === "staff";

  return (
    <div className={`flex ${fromStaff ? (isAr ? "justify-start" : "justify-start") : "justify-end"}`}>
      <div className={`max-w-[86%] rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-6 ${
        fromStaff
          ? "border-aubergine/15 bg-aubergine/5 text-espresso"
          : "border-espresso/10 bg-espresso text-milk"
      }`}>
        {fromStaff && (
          <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-black tracking-[.1em] text-aubergine/60">
            {message.sender_name || (isAr ? "فريق OH MY BABY" : "OH MY BABY team")}
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{message.body}</p>
        <p className={`mt-1 text-[10px] ${fromStaff ? "text-espresso/35" : "text-milk/55"}`}>
          {message.created_at ? new Date(message.created_at).toLocaleString(isAr ? "ar-SY" : "en-US") : ""}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SupportChatLauncher({ locale = "ar" }) {
  const isAr = locale === "ar";
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [session, setSession] = useState({ loading: true, user: null });
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState([]);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(null);
  const [newMode, setNewMode] = useState(false);
  const [orderContext, setOrderContext] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    guest_name: "",
    guest_phone: "",
    subject: "",
    message: "",
    order_reference: "",
  });
  const [reply, setReply] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const customer = session.user?.role === "customer" ? session.user : null;
  const unread = useMemo(
    () => customer
      ? conversations.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.unread || 0), 0)
      : Number(active?.unread || 0),
    [conversations, active, customer?.id]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch("/auth/session")
      .then((data) => setSession({ loading: false, user: data.user || null }))
      .catch(() => setSession({ loading: false, user: null }));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onOpen = (event) => {
      const detail = event?.detail || {};
      setOpen(true);
      setError("");
      if (detail.orderId || detail.reference) {
        setOrderContext({
          orderId: detail.orderId || null,
          reference: detail.reference || null,
        });
        setNewMode(true);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("omb:support-open", onOpen);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("omb:support-open", onOpen);
  }, []);

  async function loadMine() {
    if (!customer) return;

    try {
      const data = await apiFetch("/api/support/mine");
      setConversations(data.conversations || []);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e.status !== 401 && e.status !== 403) setError(e.message);
    }
  }

  async function loadGuestThread() {
    if (customer) return;
    const saved = readGuestThread();
    if (!saved) return;

    try {
      const data = await apiFetch(`/api/support/conversations/${saved.id}?token=${encodeURIComponent(saved.token)}`);
      setActive(data.conversation);
    } catch {
      saveGuestThread(null);
      setActive(null);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || session.loading) return;
    setError("");

    if (customer) loadMine();
    else loadGuestThread();
  }, [open, session.loading, customer?.id]);

  async function openConversation(item) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const data = customer
        ? await apiFetch(`/api/support/conversations/${item.id}`)
        : await apiFetch(`/api/support/conversations/${item.id}?token=${encodeURIComponent(item.token)}`);
      setActive(data.conversation);
      setNewMode(false);
      if (customer) await loadMine();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function createConversation(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const payload = {
        subject: form.subject.trim() || null,
        message: form.message.trim(),
        order_id: customer ? orderContext?.orderId || null : null,
        order_reference: !customer ? (orderContext?.reference || form.order_reference.trim() || null) : null,
        guest_name: customer ? null : form.guest_name.trim(),
        guest_phone: customer ? null : form.guest_phone.trim(),
      };

      const data = await apiFetch("/api/support/conversations", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const conversation = data.conversation;
      setActive(conversation);
      setNewMode(false);
      setOrderContext(null);
      setForm((current) => ({ ...current, subject: "", message: "", order_reference: "" }));

      if (customer) {
        await loadMine();
      } else {
        saveGuestThread({ id: conversation.id, token: conversation.token });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.data?.errors ? Object.values(e.data.errors).flat()[0] : e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function sendReply(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!active || !reply.trim()) return;

    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const options = {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: reply.trim(),
          token: customer ? undefined : active.token,
        }),
      };

      if (!customer && active.token) {
        options.headers = { "X-Support-Token": active.token };
      }

      const data = await apiFetch(`/api/support/conversations/${active.id}/messages`, options);
      setActive(data.conversation);
      setReply("");
      if (customer) await loadMine();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !active || active.status === "closed") return undefined;

    const timer = window.setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const data = customer
          ? await apiFetch(`/api/support/conversations/${active.id}`)
          : await apiFetch(`/api/support/conversations/${active.id}?token=${encodeURIComponent(active.token)}`);
        setActive(data.conversation);
        if (customer) loadMine();
      } catch {}
    }, 8000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [open, active?.id, active?.status, customer?.id]);

  function startNew() {
    setActive(null);
    setNewMode(true);
    setError("");
    setOrderContext(null);
  }

  const sideClass = "";

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        className={`fixed bottom-6 z-[90] flex h-14 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-aubergine/20 bg-espresso px-5 text-sm font-black text-milk shadow-2xl transition hover:-translate-y-0.5`}
        style={{ left: "24px", right: "auto" }}
        aria-label={isAr ? "محادثة الدعم" : "Support chat"}
      >
        <span className="text-lg" aria-hidden="true">✦</span>
        <span>{isAr ? "تواصل معنا" : "Contact us"}</span>
        {unread > 0 && (
          <span className="inline-flex min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-milk px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-espresso">
            {unread}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {open && (
        <section
          className={`fixed bottom-24 z-[95] flex max-h-[72vh] w-[calc(100vw-2.5rem)] max-w-[420px] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] border border-espresso/15 bg-milk shadow-2xl`}
          style={{ left: "24px", right: "auto" }}
          dir={isAr ? "rtl" : "ltr"}
        >
          <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-espresso/10 bg-oat/30 px-5 py-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-black tracking-[.16em] text-aubergine/55">OH MY BABY SUPPORT</p>
              <h2 className="mt-1 text-lg font-black text-espresso">{isAr ? "محادثات العملاء" : "Customer support"}</h2>
            </div>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="h-9 w-9 rounded-full border border-espresso/10 text-lg font-black">×</button>
          </header>

          <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5">
            {error && <p className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-red-300 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs font-bold text-red-700">{error}</p>}

            {!active && !newMode && customer && (
              <>
                <button type="button" onClick={startNew} className="omb-btn omb-btn-primary w-full">
                  {isAr ? "بدء محادثة جديدة" : "Start a new conversation"}
                </button>

                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2">
                  {conversations.length ? conversations.map((item) => (
                    <button
                      key={item.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => openConversation(item)}
                      className="rounded-2xl border border-espresso/10 bg-oat/15 p-4 text-start transition hover:border-aubergine/30"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <strong className="text-sm text-espresso">
                          {item.subject || item.order?.reference || (isAr ? "محادثة دعم" : "Support conversation")}
                        </strong>
                        {item.unread > 0 && <span className="rounded-full bg-aubergine px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-milk">{item.unread}</span>}
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 text-xs leading-5 text-espresso/50">{item.last_message?.body || "—"}</p>
                      <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] font-black text-aubergine/60">{statusLabel(item.status, isAr)}</p>
                    </button>
                  )) : (
                    <p className="rounded-2xl border border-espresso/10 p-4 text-sm text-espresso/50">
                      {isAr ? "ما عندك محادثات بعد." : "No conversations yet."}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {!active && !newMode && !customer && (
              <form onSubmit={createConversation} className="grid gap-4">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold leading-6 text-espresso/60">
                  {isAr ? "اكتب بيانات بسيطة ورسالتك، ومنرد عليك من داخل الموقع." : "Leave your contact details and message. We will reply here."}
                </p>

                <input required value={form.guest_name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, guest_name: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "الاسم" : "Name"} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 px-4 outline-none" />
                <input required type="tel" value={form.guest_phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, guest_phone: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "رقم الهاتف" : "Phone"} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 px-4 outline-none" />
                <input value={form.order_reference} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, order_reference: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "رقم الطلب — اختياري" : "Order reference — optional"} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 px-4 outline-none" />
                <input value={form.subject} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subject: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "عنوان الرسالة — اختياري" : "Subject — optional"} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 px-4 outline-none" />
                <textarea required rows="4" maxLength={3000} value={form.message} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, message: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "كيف فينا نساعدك؟" : "How can we help?"} className="rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 p-4 outline-none" />

                <button disabled={busy} className="omb-btn omb-btn-primary w-full disabled:opacity-40">
                  {busy ? (isAr ? "جاري الإرسال..." : "Sending...") : (isAr ? "إرسال الرسالة" : "Send message")}
                </button>
              </form>
            )}

            {!active && newMode && (
              <form onSubmit={createConversation} className="grid gap-4">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setNewMode(false); setOrderContext(null); }} className="w-fit text-xs font-black text-aubergine underline">
                  {isAr ? "رجوع للمحادثات" : "Back to conversations"}
                </button>

                {orderContext?.reference && (
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-aubergine/15 bg-aubergine/5 p-3 text-xs font-bold">
                    {isAr ? `الاستفسار مرتبط بالطلب ${orderContext.reference}` : `Question about order ${orderContext.reference}`}
                  </div>
                )}

                {!customer && (
                  <>
                    <input required value={form.guest_name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, guest_name: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "الاسم" : "Name"} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 px-4 outline-none" />
                    <input required type="tel" value={form.guest_phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, guest_phone: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "رقم الهاتف" : "Phone"} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 px-4 outline-none" />
                  </>
                )}

                <input value={form.subject} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subject: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "عنوان الرسالة — اختياري" : "Subject — optional"} className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 px-4 outline-none" />
                <textarea required rows="5" maxLength={3000} value={form.message} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, message: e.target.value })} placeholder={isAr ? "اكتب رسالتك..." : "Write your message..."} className="rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 p-4 outline-none" />

                <button disabled={busy} className="omb-btn omb-btn-primary w-full disabled:opacity-40">
                  {busy ? (isAr ? "جاري الإرسال..." : "Sending...") : (isAr ? "بدء المحادثة" : "Start conversation")}
                </button>
              </form>
            )}

            {active && (
              <div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-espresso/10 pb-4">
                  <div>
                    <strong className="text-sm text-espresso">
                      {active.subject || active.order?.reference || (isAr ? "محادثة دعم" : "Support conversation")}
                    </strong>
                    {active.order?.reference && <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-espresso/45">{active.order.reference}</p>}
                  </div>
                  <span className="rounded-full border border-aubergine/15 bg-aubergine/5 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-black text-aubergine">
                    {statusLabel(active.status, isAr)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3">
                  {(active.messages || []).map((message) => <Message key={message.id} message={message} isAr={isAr} />)}
                </div>

                {active.status !== "closed" ? (
                  <form onSubmit={sendReply} className="mt-5 border-t border-espresso/10 pt-4">
                    <textarea rows="3" maxLength={3000} required value={reply} onChange={(e) => setReply(e.target.value)} placeholder={isAr ? "اكتب ردك..." : "Write a reply..."} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-espresso/12 bg-oat/10 p-3 text-sm outline-none" />
                    <button disabled={busy || !reply.trim()} className="omb-btn omb-btn-primary mt-3 w-full disabled:opacity-40">
                      {isAr ? "إرسال الرد" : "Send reply"}
                    </button>
                  </form>
                ) : (
                  <div className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-espresso/10 bg-oat/20 p-4 text-xs font-semibold leading-5 text-espresso/55">
                    {isAr ? "تم إغلاق هذه المحادثة. إذا احتجت مساعدة جديدة، ابدأ محادثة جديدة." : "This conversation is closed. Start a new one if you need more help."}
                  </div>
                )}

                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setActive(null); if (!customer) { saveGuestThread(null); setNewMode(false); } }} className="mt-4 text-xs font-black text-aubergine underline">
                  {customer ? (isAr ? "كل المحادثات" : "All conversations") : (isAr ? "بدء محادثة جديدة" : "Start a new conversation")}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </>
  );
}


===== FILE: \oh-my-baby-owner-account-safety-v1\PATCH_INSTALL_AR.md =====
# تركيب Patch إدارة الحسابات الآمنة

## قبل التركيب
1. احتفظ بنسخة من المشروع الحالي/commit الحالي.
2. خذ نسخة احتياطية من قاعدة البيانات قبل تشغيل migration جديد.

## التركيب
- انسخ محتويات هذا الـZIP فوق مجلد `website` مع Replace.

ثم من PowerShell داخل `website`:

```powershell
php artisan migrate
php artisan optimize:clear
```

إذا `npm run dev` شغال، اعمل Refresh. إذا غير شغال شغّله بالطريقة المعتادة عندك.

## اختبار آلي

```powershell
php artisan test --filter=TeamManagementSecurityTest
```

## اختبار يدوي من Owner
1. افتح `/owner/team`.
2. تحقق أن الحسابات القديمة تظهر.
3. الحساب غير المستخدم يظهر له زر **حذف نهائي آمن**.
4. الحساب المرتبط بطلبات/سجلات لا يظهر له حذف نهائي؛ يظهر سبب الحماية ويُستخدم إيقاف الحساب بدلًا منه.
5. أنشئ Admin تجريبي مؤقت داخل الموقع بصلاحية واحدة على الأقل، ثم عدّل بياناته، أوقفه، أعد تفعيله، ثم احذفه إذا بقي غير مستخدم.
6. لا تحذف أي حساب حقيقي مرتبط بالطلبات أثناء الاختبار.

## ملاحظة مهمة
Migration رقم `2026_09_27_000001_normalize_and_unique_user_phones.php` يضيف unique constraint لأرقام الهاتف بعد normalization. إذا وجد أرقامًا تاريخية تتطابق بعد إزالة المسافات/الشرطات، سيتوقف برسالة واضحة بدل تعديل البيانات بشكل تخميني. عندها لا تحاول تجاوز الخطأ؛ عالج الحسابات المتعارضة أولًا.


===== FILE: \oh-my-baby-owner-account-safety-v1\app\Http\Controllers\AuthController.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function session(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        return response()->json([
            'authenticated' => (bool) $user,
            'user' => $user ? $this->safeUser($user) : null,
        ]);
    }

    public function login(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'identifier' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:180', 'required_without:phone'],
            'phone' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:40', 'required_without:identifier'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
            'remember' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
        ]);

        $identifier = trim((string) ($data['identifier'] ?? $data['phone'] ?? ''));

        if (filter_var($identifier, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            $user = User::whereRaw('LOWER(email) = ?', [mb_strtolower($identifier)])->first();
        } else {
            $user = User::where('phone', $this->normalizePhone($identifier))->first();
        }

        if (! $user || ! Hash::check($data['password'], $user->password)) {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'رقم الهاتف أو البريد الإلكتروني أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.',
            ], 422);
        }

        if (($user->account_status ?? 'active') !== 'active') {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'هذا الحساب موقوف. تواصل مع إدارة المتجر.',
                'code' => 'account_suspended',
            ], 403);
        }

        Auth::login($user, $request->boolean('remember'));
        $request->session()->regenerate();
        $user->forceFill(['last_login_at' => now()])->save();

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Signed in.',
            'user' => $this->safeUser($user),
            'redirect' => $this->dashboardForRole($user->role),
        ]);
    }

    public function register(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        if ($request->filled('phone')) {
            $request->merge(['phone' => $this->normalizePhone((string) $request->input('phone'))]);
        }
        if ($request->filled('email')) {
            $request->merge(['email' => mb_strtolower(trim((string) $request->input('email')))]);
        }

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'phone' => [
                'required',
                'string',
                'max:40',
                Rule::unique('users', 'phone'),
            ],
            'email' => [
                'nullable',
                'email',
                'max:180',
                Rule::unique('users', 'email'),
            ],
            'password' => ['required', 'confirmed', Password::min(8)],
            'marketing_opt_in' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
        ], [
            'name.required' => 'الاسم مطلوب.',
            'phone.required' => 'رقم الهاتف مطلوب.',
            'phone.unique' => 'رقم الهاتف مستخدم من قبل.',
            'email.email' => 'صيغة البريد الإلكتروني غير صحيحة.',
            'email.unique' => 'البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم من قبل.',
            'password.required' => 'كلمة المرور مطلوبة.',
            'password.confirmed' => 'تأكيد كلمة المرور غير مطابق.',
        ]);

        $phone = $this->normalizePhone($data['phone']);
        $email = $data['email'] ?? null;

        $user = User::create([
            'name' => $data['name'],
            'email' => $email ?: $this->internalEmailForPhone($phone),
            'phone' => $phone,
            'password' => $data['password'],
            'role' => 'customer',
        ]);

        $user->forceFill([
            'marketing_opt_in' => $request->boolean('marketing_opt_in'),
        ])->save();

        Auth::login($user);
        $request->session()->regenerate();

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Account created.',
            'user' => $this->safeUser($user),
            'redirect' => $this->dashboardForRole($user->role),
        ], 201);
    }

    public function logout(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        Auth::logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Signed out.']);
    }

    private function normalizePhone(string $phone): string
    {
        $phone = trim($phone);
        $phone = str_replace([' ', '-', '(', ')'], '', $phone);

        return $phone;
    }

    private function internalEmailForPhone(string $phone): string
    {
        $clean = preg_replace('/[^0-9a-zA-Z]/', '', $phone) ?: uniqid('customer', true);

        return 'phone_' . $clean . '@ohmybaby.local';
    }

    private function isInternalPhoneEmail(?string $email): bool
    {
        return is_string($email) && str_ends_with($email, '@ohmybaby.local');
    }

    private function dashboardForRole(string $role): string
    {
        return match ($role) {
            'owner' => '/owner',
            'admin' => '/admin',
            'delivery' => '/delivery',
            default => '/account',
        };
    }

    private function safeUser(User $user): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $user->id,
            'name' => $user->name,
            'email' => $this->isInternalPhoneEmail($user->email) ? null : $user->email,
            'phone' => $user->phone,
            'role' => $user->role,
            'avatar_url' => $user->avatar_url,
            'google_connected' => filled($user->google_id),
            'marketing_opt_in' => (bool) ($user->marketing_opt_in ?? false),
        ];
    }
}

===== FILE: \oh-my-baby-owner-account-safety-v1\app\Http\Controllers\TeamManagementController.php =====
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\StaffActionLog;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\PermissionCatalog;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class TeamManagementController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        $this->assertCanViewTeam($actor);

        $users = User::query()
            ->whereIn('role', ['admin', 'delivery', 'customer'])
            ->orderByRaw("CASE role WHEN 'admin' THEN 1 WHEN 'delivery' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END")
            ->orderByDesc('is_primary_admin')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get([
                'id', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'is_primary_admin', 'permissions', 'permissions_updated_at',
                'account_status', 'last_login_at', 'suspended_at', 'suspension_reason', 'created_by', 'created_at',
            ]);

        if ($actor->role === 'owner') {
            $users->each(function (User $user): void {
                $user->setAttribute('deletion', $this->deletionAssessment($user));
            });
        }

        $logs = $actor->role === 'owner'
            ? StaffActionLog::query()
                ->with(['actor:id,name,email,role', 'target:id,name,email,role'])
                ->latest()
                ->limit(60)
                ->get()
            : collect();

        return response()->json([
            'viewer_id' => $actor->id,
            'viewer_role' => $actor->role,
            'viewer_is_primary_admin' => (bool) $actor->is_primary_admin,
            'viewer_effective_permissions' => PermissionCatalog::effectiveFor($actor),
            'creatable_roles' => $this->creatableRoles($actor),
            'permission_dependencies' => PermissionCatalog::dependencies(),
            'permission_groups' => [
                'admin' => $this->filteredGroupsForActor($actor, 'admin'),
                'delivery' => $this->filteredGroupsForActor($actor, 'delivery'),
            ],
            'users' => $users,
            'summary' => [
                'admins' => User::where('role', 'admin')->count(),
                'active_admins' => User::where('role', 'admin')->where('account_status', 'active')->count(),
                'drivers' => User::where('role', 'delivery')->count(),
                'active_drivers' => User::where('role', 'delivery')->where('account_status', 'active')->count(),
                'customers' => User::where('role', 'customer')->count(),
            ],
            'activity' => $logs,
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        $creatableRoles = $this->creatableRoles($actor);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'email' => ['required', 'email', 'max:180'],
            'phone' => ['required', 'string', 'max:40'],
            'role' => ['required', Rule::in($creatableRoles)],
            'password' => ['required', Password::min(8)],
            'permissions' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'permissions.*' => ['string', 'max:100'],
        ]);

        $email = $this->normalizeEmail($data['email']);
        $phone = $this->normalizePhone($data['phone']);
        $this->assertIdentityAvailable($email, $phone);

        $permissions = $this->validatedAssignment($actor, $data['role'], $data['permissions'] ?? []);
        if (in_array($data['role'], ['admin', 'delivery'], true) && count($permissions) === 0) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'permissions' => ['Choose at least one permission for Admin or Delivery accounts.'],
            ]);
        }

        $user = DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $data, $email, $phone, $permissions): User {
            $user = new User();
            $user->forceFill([
                'name' => trim($data['name']),
                'email' => $email,
                'phone' => $phone,
                'role' => $data['role'],
                'password' => $data['password'],
                'permissions' => $data['role'] === 'customer' ? [] : $permissions,
                'permissions_updated_at' => now(),
                'permissions_updated_by' => $actor->id,
                'is_primary_admin' => false,
                'account_status' => 'active',
                'created_by' => $actor->id,
            ]);
            $user->save();

            $this->log($actor, $user, 'staff_created', 'Created '.$user->role.' account.', [
                'permissions' => $user->permissions ?? [],
            ]);

            return $user;
        });

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Account created.',
            'user' => $user->only(['id', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'is_primary_admin', 'permissions', 'account_status']),
        ], 201);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, User $user): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        $this->assertCanEdit($actor, $user);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'email' => ['required', 'email', 'max:180'],
            'phone' => ['required', 'string', 'max:40'],
            'password' => ['nullable', Password::min(8)],
            'permissions' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'permissions.*' => ['string', 'max:100'],
        ]);

        $email = $this->normalizeEmail($data['email']);
        $phone = $this->normalizePhone($data['phone']);
        $this->assertIdentityAvailable($email, $phone, $user->id);

        $before = $user->only(['name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'permissions', 'account_status', 'is_primary_admin']);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $user, $data, $email, $phone, $before): void {
            $updates = [
                'name' => trim($data['name']),
                'email' => $email,
                'phone' => $phone,
            ];

            if (! empty($data['password'])) {
                $updates['password'] = $data['password'];
            }

            if (in_array($user->role, ['admin', 'delivery'], true) && ! $user->is_primary_admin) {
                abort_unless($this->can($actor, 'team.manage_permissions'), 403, 'You cannot edit permissions.');
                abort_if($actor->id === $user->id, 403, 'You cannot edit your own permissions here.');
                $assignable = PermissionCatalog::assignableBy($actor, $user->role);
                $requested = $this->validatedAssignment($actor, $user->role, $data['permissions'] ?? []);
                if (count($requested) === 0) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'permissions' => ['Admin and Delivery accounts must keep at least one permission.'],
                    ]);
                }
                $existing = is_array($user->permissions) ? $user->permissions : [];
                $lockedExisting = array_values(array_diff($existing, $assignable));
                $updates['permissions'] = array_values(array_unique([...$lockedExisting, ...$requested]));
                $updates['permissions_updated_at'] = now();
                $updates['permissions_updated_by'] = $actor->id;
            }

            $user->forceFill($updates)->save();

            if (! empty($data['password'])) {
                $this->invalidateSessions($user->id);
            }

            $this->log($actor, $user, 'account_updated', 'Updated account details and permissions.', [
                'before' => $before,
                'after' => $user->only(['name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'permissions', 'account_status', 'is_primary_admin']),
                'password_changed' => ! empty($data['password']),
            ]);
        });

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Account updated.',
            'user' => $user->fresh()->only(['id', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'is_primary_admin', 'permissions', 'account_status']),
        ]);
    }

    public function suspend(Request $request, User $user): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        abort_unless($this->can($actor, 'team.suspend_accounts'), 403);
        $this->assertCanManageTarget($actor, $user);
        abort_if($actor->id === $user->id, 422, 'You cannot suspend your own account.');
        abort_if($user->role === 'owner', 403, 'Owner accounts cannot be suspended here.');
        abort_if($user->is_primary_admin, 422, 'Assign another primary Admin before suspending this account.');

        $data = $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);
        $reason = trim($data['reason']);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $user, $reason): void {
            $user->forceFill([
                'account_status' => 'suspended',
                'suspended_at' => now(),
                'suspended_by' => $actor->id,
                'suspension_reason' => $reason,
            ])->save();

            $this->invalidateSessions($user->id);
            $this->log($actor, $user, 'account_suspended', $reason);
        });

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Account suspended.']);
    }

    public function reactivate(Request $request, User $user): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        abort_unless($this->can($actor, 'team.suspend_accounts'), 403);
        $this->assertCanManageTarget($actor, $user);
        abort_if($user->role === 'owner', 403, 'Owner accounts cannot be managed here.');

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $user): void {
            $user->forceFill([
                'account_status' => 'active',
                'suspended_at' => null,
                'suspended_by' => null,
                'suspension_reason' => null,
            ])->save();

            $this->log($actor, $user, 'account_reactivated', 'Account reactivated.');
        });

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Account reactivated.']);
    }

    public function makePrimaryAdmin(Request $request, User $user): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        abort_unless($actor->role === 'owner', 403);
        abort_unless($user->role === 'admin', 422, 'Only an Admin can become primary Admin.');
        abort_unless(($user->account_status ?? 'active') === 'active', 422, 'Reactivate this Admin before making it primary.');

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $user): void {
            User::query()->where('role', 'admin')->lockForUpdate()->get(['id']);
            User::where('role', 'admin')->update(['is_primary_admin' => false]);
            $user->forceFill(['is_primary_admin' => true])->save();
            $this->log($actor, $user, 'primary_admin_assigned', 'Assigned as primary Admin.');
        });

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Primary Admin updated.']);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, User $user): JsonResponse
    {
        $actor = $request->user();
        abort_unless($actor->role === 'owner', 403);
        abort_if($actor->id === $user->id, 422, 'You cannot delete your own Owner account.');
        abort_if($user->role === 'owner', 403, 'Owner accounts cannot be deleted here.');
        abort_if((bool) $user->is_primary_admin, 422, 'Assign another primary Admin before deleting this account.');

        $assessment = $this->deletionAssessment($user);
        if (! $assessment['can_delete']) {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'This account has linked business data and cannot be permanently deleted. Suspend it instead.',
                'blockers' => $assessment['blockers'],
            ], 422);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $user): void {
            $snapshot = $this->targetSnapshot($user);
            $this->log($actor, $user, 'account_deleted', 'Permanently deleted an unused account.', [
                'deleted_account' => $snapshot,
            ]);

            $this->invalidateSessions($user->id);
            if (Schema::hasTable('password_reset_tokens')) {
                DB::table('password_reset_tokens')->where('email', $user->email)->delete();
            }

            // These columns intentionally have no FK constraints in the current schema.
            // Null them before deletion so we never leave dangling account-management references.
            User::where('created_by', $user->id)->update(['created_by' => null]);
            User::where('permissions_updated_by', $user->id)->update(['permissions_updated_by' => null]);
            User::where('suspended_by', $user->id)->update(['suspended_by' => null]);

            $user->delete();
        });

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Unused account deleted permanently.']);
    }

    private function assertCanViewTeam(User $actor): void
    {
        abort_unless($actor->role === 'owner' || $this->can($actor, 'team.view'), 403);
    }

    private function assertCanEdit(User $actor, User $target): void
    {
        abort_unless($this->can($actor, 'team.edit_accounts'), 403);
        $this->assertCanManageTarget($actor, $target);
    }

    private function assertCanManageTarget(User $actor, User $target): void
    {
        abort_if($target->role === 'owner', 403, 'Owner account cannot be managed here.');

        if ($actor->role === 'owner') {
            return;
        }

        abort_unless($actor->role === 'admin', 403);
        abort_if($target->role === 'admin' && (bool) $target->is_primary_admin, 403, 'Primary Admin can only be managed by Owner.');

        if ($target->role === 'admin') {
            abort_unless($this->can($actor, 'team.create_admin') || $this->can($actor, 'team.manage_permissions'), 403);
        }
    }

    private function creatableRoles(User $actor): array
    {
        if ($actor->role === 'owner') {
            return ['admin', 'delivery', 'customer'];
        }

        $roles = [];
        $canDelegate = $this->can($actor, 'team.manage_permissions');
        if ($canDelegate && $this->can($actor, 'team.create_admin')) $roles[] = 'admin';
        if ($canDelegate && $this->can($actor, 'team.create_delivery')) $roles[] = 'delivery';
        if ($this->can($actor, 'team.create_customer')) $roles[] = 'customer';
        return $roles;
    }

    private function filteredGroupsForActor(User $actor, string $role): array
    {
        $assignable = PermissionCatalog::assignableBy($actor, $role);
        $groups = PermissionCatalog::groupsForRole($role);

        return array_values(array_filter(array_map(function (array $group) use ($assignable) {
            $group['items'] = array_values(array_filter(
                $group['items'],
                fn (array $item) => in_array($item['code'], $assignable, true)
            ));
            return $group;
        }, $groups), fn (array $group) => count($group['items']) > 0));
    }

    private function validatedAssignment(User $actor, string $targetRole, array $requested): array
    {
        if ($targetRole === 'customer') {
            return [];
        }

        if ($actor->role !== 'owner' && ! $this->can($actor, 'team.manage_permissions')) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'permissions' => ['You do not have permission to delegate account permissions.'],
            ]);
        }

        $assignable = PermissionCatalog::assignableBy($actor, $targetRole);
        $unknownOrForbidden = array_values(array_diff(array_unique($requested), $assignable));
        if ($unknownOrForbidden) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'permissions' => ['You cannot grant one or more selected permissions.'],
            ]);
        }

        return PermissionCatalog::sanitizeForAssignment($actor, $targetRole, $requested);
    }

    private function can(User $actor, string $permission): bool
    {
        return PermissionCatalog::has($actor, $permission);
    }

    private function log(User $actor, User $target, string $action, ?string $note = null, array $meta = []): void
    {
        StaffActionLog::create([
            'actor_user_id' => $actor->id,
            'target_user_id' => $target->id,
            'action' => $action,
            'note' => $note,
            'meta' => [
                'target_role' => $target->role,
                'target_snapshot' => $this->targetSnapshot($target),
                ...$meta,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    private function targetSnapshot(User $user): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $user->id,
            'name' => $user->name,
            'email' => $user->email,
            'phone' => $user->phone,
            'role' => $user->role,
        ];
    }

    private function normalizeEmail(string $email): string
    {
        return mb_strtolower(trim($email));
    }

    private function normalizePhone(string $phone): string
    {
        return str_replace([' ', '-', '(', ')'], '', trim($phone));
    }

    private function assertIdentityAvailable(string $email, string $phone, ?int $ignoreUserId = null): void
    {
        $emailExists = User::query()
            ->when($ignoreUserId, fn ($q) => $q->where('id', '!=', $ignoreUserId))
            ->whereRaw('LOWER(email) = ?', [$email])
            ->exists();

        if ($emailExists) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['email' => ['This email is already in use.']]);
        }

        $phoneExists = User::query()
            ->when($ignoreUserId, fn ($q) => $q->where('id', '!=', $ignoreUserId))
            ->where('phone', $phone)
            ->exists();

        if ($phoneExists) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['phone' => ['This phone number is already in use.']]);
        }
    }

    private function invalidateSessions(int $userId): void
    {
        if (Schema::hasTable('sessions') && Schema::hasColumn('sessions', 'user_id')) {
            DB::table('sessions')->where('user_id', $userId)->delete();
        }
    }

    private function deletionAssessment(User $user): array
    {
        if ($user->role === 'owner') {
            return ['can_delete' => false, 'blockers' => ['owner_account']];
        }

        if ((bool) $user->is_primary_admin) {
            return ['can_delete' => false, 'blockers' => ['primary_admin']];
        }

        $checks = [
            ['orders', 'user_id', 'customer_orders'],
            ['orders', 'assigned_delivery_id', 'assigned_deliveries'],
            ['orders', 'return_delivery_id', 'return_deliveries'],
            ['order_events', 'actor_user_id', 'order_history'],
            ['reward_coupons', 'user_id', 'reward_coupons'],
            ['owner_requests', 'admin_id', 'owner_requests'],
            ['owner_requests', 'reviewed_by', 'reviewed_owner_requests'],
            ['catalog_products', 'created_by', 'created_products'],
            ['catalog_products', 'updated_by', 'updated_products'],
            ['wishlist_items', 'user_id', 'wishlist'],
            ['product_reviews', 'user_id', 'product_reviews'],
            ['interest_poll_votes', 'user_id', 'poll_votes'],
            ['customer_feedback', 'user_id', 'customer_feedback'],
        ];

        $blockers = [];
        foreach ($checks as [$table, $column, $label]) {
            if (! Schema::hasTable($table) || ! Schema::hasColumn($table, $column)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (DB::table($table)->where($column, $user->id)->exists()) {
                $blockers[] = $label;
            }
        }

        return [
            'can_delete' => count($blockers) === 0,
            'blockers' => $blockers,
        ];
    }
}

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable('users') || ! Schema::hasColumn('users', 'phone')) {
            return;
        }

        $rows = DB::table('users')
            ->whereNotNull('phone')
            ->where('phone', '!=', '')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get(['id', 'phone']);

        $normalizedById = [];
        $owners = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $normalized = str_replace([' ', '-', '(', ')'], '', trim((string) $row->phone));
            if ($normalized === '') {
                continue;
            }

            if (isset($owners[$normalized])) {
                throw new \RuntimeException(
                    'Cannot add a unique phone constraint because users '.$owners[$normalized].' and '.$row->id.' normalize to the same phone: '.$normalized
                );
            }

            $owners[$normalized] = $row->id;
            $normalizedById[$row->id] = $normalized;
        }

        foreach ($normalizedById as $id => $normalized) {
            DB::table('users')->where('id', $id)->update(['phone' => $normalized]);
        }

        Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->unique('phone', 'users_phone_unique');
        });
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable('users') || ! Schema::hasColumn('users', 'phone')) {
            return;
        }

        Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->dropUnique('users_phone_unique');
        });
    }
};

===== FILE: \oh-my-baby-owner-account-safety-v1\docs\ACCOUNT_MANAGEMENT_SECURITY.md =====
# OH MY BABY — Account Management Safety Rules

This document describes the rules used by the Owner account-management screen.

## Core rule
Operational account management must happen from `/owner/team`, not from Tinker during normal use.
Tinker remains an emergency/development tool only.

## Owner capabilities
- Create Admin / Delivery / Customer accounts.
- Edit name, email, phone and delegated permissions.
- Change a password when necessary.
- Suspend / reactivate accounts.
- Assign the Primary Admin.
- Permanently delete **only an unused account with no linked business history**.

## Permanent deletion protection
Permanent deletion is intentionally blocked when an account is linked to business data such as:
- customer orders
- assigned deliveries or return deliveries
- order event history
- reward coupons
- owner requests
- catalog-product attribution
- wishlist / product reviews
- poll votes / customer feedback

If an account has business history, suspend it instead. This prevents accidental deletion of order, delivery, audit or financial context.

The Owner account cannot be deleted from the team screen.
The Primary Admin must first be reassigned before it can be suspended or permanently deleted.

## Atomic writes
Create, update, suspend, reactivate, Primary Admin reassignment and permanent deletion are wrapped in database transactions. A failed operation is rolled back instead of leaving half-applied state.

## Identity rules
- Emails are normalized to lowercase.
- Phones are normalized by removing spaces, dashes and parentheses.
- Email and phone duplication is rejected server-side.
- A database migration normalizes existing phones and adds a unique phone index. If historical duplicates exist, the migration stops with an explicit error instead of guessing which account should win.

## Sessions
Suspending an account, changing its password, or permanently deleting it invalidates database sessions for that user when the `sessions` table is in use.
A suspended account is also rejected directly by the login endpoint.

## Audit trail
Sensitive account-management actions continue to be written to `staff_action_logs`.
New log entries include a target-account snapshot so history remains understandable even if an unused account is later permanently deleted.

## Demo accounts
`DatabaseSeeder` no longer creates demo accounts.
`DemoAccountsSeeder` is permanently retired and throws if called manually.

## Test command
After applying the patch and running migrations:

```powershell
php artisan test --filter=TeamManagementSecurityTest
```

Then manually test `/owner/team` with the real Owner account before creating production staff accounts.
