===== FILE: \resources\js\data\productStore.js =====
import { mockProducts } from "./mockProducts";

export const PRODUCTS_STORAGE_KEY = "omb-admin-products";
export const CART_STORAGE_KEY = "omb-cart";
export const WISHLIST_STORAGE_KEY = "omb-wishlist";
export const CATALOG_SCHEMA_KEY = "omb-catalog-schema";
export const CATALOG_BACKUP_KEY = "omb-admin-products-before-v2";
const CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2;

function safeParse(value, fallback) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export function inventoryKey(colorId = "default", size = "default") {
  return `${colorId || "default"}::${size || "default"}`;
}

function buildFallbackInventory(colors, sizes, defaultStock = 4) {
  const inventory = {};
  const colorIds = colors.length ? colors.map((color) => color.id) : ["default"];
  const sizeIds = sizes.length ? sizes : ["default"];
  colorIds.forEach((colorId) => {
    sizeIds.forEach((size) => {
      inventory[inventoryKey(colorId, size)] = defaultStock;
    });
  });
  return inventory;
}

export function normalizeProduct(product) {
  const rawColors = Array.isArray(product.colors) ? product.colors : [];
  const colors = rawColors.map((color) => {
    const images = Array.isArray(color.images)
      ? color.images.filter(Boolean)
      : color.image
        ? [color.image]
        : [];
    return {
      ...color,
      image: color.image || images[0] || product.image || "",
      images,
    };
  });
  const sizes = Array.isArray(product.sizes) ? product.sizes : [];
  const inventory = Object.keys(product.inventory || {}).length
    ? { ...product.inventory }
    : buildFallbackInventory(colors, sizes, Number(product.stock ?? 4));
  const firstColorImage = colors.find((color) => color.image)?.image;

  return {
    ...product,
    world:
      product.world ||
      (["newborn", "girls", "boys", "shoes", "accessories"].includes(product.category)
        ? "fashion"
        : "baby-world"),
    subcategory: product.subcategory || "all",
    slug: product.slug || `product-${product.id}`,
    status: product.status || "active",
    sections: Array.isArray(product.sections) ? product.sections : [],
    // Every catalog product must belong to summer, winter, or both.
    // Legacy products that predate the season flags are treated as both so
    // the new filters never hide the existing catalog by accident.
    isSummer: Boolean(product.isSummer) || (!Boolean(product.isSummer) && !Boolean(product.isWinter)),
    isWinter: Boolean(product.isWinter) || (!Boolean(product.isSummer) && !Boolean(product.isWinter)),
    bestSellerPinned: Boolean(product.bestSellerPinned),
    bestSellerOrder: Number(product.bestSellerOrder || 0),
    offerPrice: product.offerPrice === "" || product.offerPrice == null ? null : Number(product.offerPrice),
    price: Number(product.price || 0),
    colors,
    sizes,
    inventory,
    image: product.image || firstColorImage || "/images/products/product-01-dress.jpg",
  };
}

function migrateLegacyProducts(savedProducts) {
  const defaultsById = new Map(mockProducts.map((product) => [String(product.id), product]));
  const savedById = new Map(
    savedProducts.map((product) => [String(product.id), product]),
  );

  // Keep any previous user/admin edits, but backfill the new catalog structure
  // (world, subcategory, inventory, etc.) from the upgraded demo catalog.
  const mergedDefaults = mockProducts.map((product) => {
    const saved = savedById.get(String(product.id));
    if (!saved) return product;
    return {
      ...product,
      ...saved,
      world: saved.world || product.world,
      subcategory: saved.subcategory || product.subcategory,
      sections: Array.isArray(saved.sections) ? saved.sections : product.sections,
      colors: Array.isArray(saved.colors) && saved.colors.length ? saved.colors : product.colors,
      sizes: Array.isArray(saved.sizes) && saved.sizes.length ? saved.sizes : product.sizes,
      inventory:
        saved.inventory && Object.keys(saved.inventory).length
          ? saved.inventory
          : product.inventory,
    };
  });

  const customProducts = savedProducts.filter(
    (product) => !defaultsById.has(String(product.id)),
  );

  return [...customProducts, ...mergedDefaults].map(normalizeProduct);
}

export function getProducts() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return mockProducts.map(normalizeProduct);

  const saved = safeParse(window.localStorage.getItem(PRODUCTS_STORAGE_KEY), null);
  const schemaVersion = Number(window.localStorage.getItem(CATALOG_SCHEMA_KEY) || 1);
  if (!Array.isArray(saved)) return mockProducts.map(normalizeProduct);
  if (!saved.length) {
    return schemaVersion >= CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION
      ? []
      : mockProducts.map(normalizeProduct);
  }

  if (schemaVersion < CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    try {
      if (!window.localStorage.getItem(CATALOG_BACKUP_KEY)) {
        window.localStorage.setItem(CATALOG_BACKUP_KEY, JSON.stringify(saved));
      }
      const migrated = migrateLegacyProducts(saved);
      window.localStorage.setItem(PRODUCTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(migrated));
      window.localStorage.setItem(CATALOG_SCHEMA_KEY, String(CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION));
      return migrated;
    } catch {
      // If storage is unavailable/full, keep the old products rather than losing them.
      return saved.map(normalizeProduct);
    }
  }

  return saved.map(normalizeProduct);
}

export function saveProducts(products) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return { ok: false, reason: "no-window" };
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(
      PRODUCTS_STORAGE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify(products.map(normalizeProduct)),
    );
    window.localStorage.setItem(CATALOG_SCHEMA_KEY, String(CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("omb:products-updated"));
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: error?.name === "QuotaExceededError" ? "storage-full" : "storage-error",
    };
  }
}

export function getProductById(productId) {
  return getProducts().find((product) => String(product.id) === String(productId)) || null;
}

export function getProductsForSection(section) {
  return getProducts().filter(
    (product) => product.status !== "inactive" && product.sections?.includes(section),
  );
}

export function getVariantStock(product, colorId = "default", size = "default") {
  const normalized = normalizeProduct(product);
  return Math.max(
    0,
    Number(normalized.inventory?.[inventoryKey(colorId, size)] || 0),
  );
}

export function getProductStock(product) {
  return Object.values(normalizeProduct(product).inventory || {}).reduce(
    (sum, value) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(value || 0)),
    0,
  );
}

export function isProductOutOfStock(product) {
  return getProductStock(product) <= 0;
}

export function getAvailableSizesForColor(product, colorId = "default") {
  const normalized = normalizeProduct(product);
  if (!normalized.sizes.length) return [];
  return normalized.sizes.filter(
    (size) => getVariantStock(normalized, colorId, size) > 0,
  );
}

export function getAvailableColors(product) {
  const normalized = normalizeProduct(product);
  if (!normalized.colors.length) return [];
  return normalized.colors.filter((color) => {
    if (!normalized.sizes.length) {
      return getVariantStock(normalized, color.id, "default") > 0;
    }
    return normalized.sizes.some(
      (size) => getVariantStock(normalized, color.id, size) > 0,
    );
  });
}

export function getCart() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  const cart = safeParse(window.localStorage.getItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY), []);
  return Array.isArray(cart) ? cart : [];
}

function saveCart(cart) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.localStorage.setItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cart));
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("omb:cart-updated"));
}

export function getCartQuantity(
  productId,
  colorId = "default",
  size = "default",
) {
  return getCart()
    .filter(
      (item) =>
        String(item.productId) === String(productId) &&
        (item.colorId || "default") === (colorId || "default") &&
        (item.size || "default") === (size || "default"),
    )
    .reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.quantity || 0), 0);
}

export function addToCart(
  product,
  { colorId = "default", size = "default", quantity = 1 } = {},
) {
  const stock = getVariantStock(product, colorId, size);
  const cart = getCart();
  const key = `${product.id}::${colorId || "default"}::${size || "default"}`;
  const existingIndex = cart.findIndex((item) => item.key === key);
  const existingQuantity =
    existingIndex >= 0 ? Number(cart[existingIndex].quantity || 0) : 0;
  const requested = existingQuantity + Number(quantity || 0);

  if (stock <= 0) return { ok: false, reason: "out-of-stock", available: 0, stock };
  if (requested > stock) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "max-stock",
      available: Math.max(0, stock - existingQuantity),
      stock,
    };
  }

  const nextItem = {
    key,
    productId: product.id,
    colorId: colorId || "default",
    size: size || "default",
    quantity: requested,
    addedAt: Date.now(),
  };
  if (existingIndex >= 0) cart[existingIndex] = nextItem;
  else cart.push(nextItem);
  saveCart(cart);
  return { ok: true, quantity: requested, stock };
}

export function setCartItemQuantity(key, quantity) {
  const cart = getCart();
  const index = cart.findIndex((item) => item.key === key);
  if (index < 0) return { ok: false, reason: "missing" };
  const item = cart[index];
  const product = getProductById(item.productId);
  if (!product) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-product" };
  const stock = getVariantStock(product, item.colorId, item.size);
  const nextQuantity = Math.max(1, Number(quantity || 1));
  if (nextQuantity > stock) return { ok: false, reason: "max-stock", stock };
  cart[index] = { ...item, quantity: nextQuantity };
  saveCart(cart);
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("omb:cart-added", {
      detail: { productId: product.id, productName: product.name, productNameEn: product.nameEn || product.name, quantity },
    }));
  }
  return { ok: true, quantity: nextQuantity, stock };
}

export function removeCartItem(key) {
  saveCart(getCart().filter((item) => item.key !== key));
}

export function clearCart() {
  saveCart([]);
}

export function getCartCount() {
  return getCart().reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.quantity || 0), 0);
}

export function getCartDetailed() {
  return getCart()
    .map((item) => {
      const product = getProductById(item.productId);
      if (!product) return null;
      const color = product.colors?.find((entry) => entry.id === item.colorId) || null;
      const price = Number(product.offerPrice ?? product.price ?? 0);
      return {
        ...item,
        product,
        color,
        price,
        subtotal: price * Number(item.quantity || 0),
        stock: getVariantStock(product, item.colorId, item.size),
      };
    })
    .filter(Boolean);
}

export function getWishlist() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  const list = safeParse(window.localStorage.getItem(WISHLIST_STORAGE_KEY), []);
  return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
}

export function toggleWishlist(productId) {
  const current = getWishlist().map(String);
  const id = String(productId);
  const next = current.includes(id)
    ? current.filter((item) => item !== id)
    : [...current, id];
  window.localStorage.setItem(WISHLIST_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("omb:wishlist-updated"));
  return next.includes(id);
}

===== FILE: \resources\js\hooks\useExchangeRate.js =====
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { apiFetch } from "../lib/api";

const CACHE_KEY = "omb:exchange-rate";
const CLIENT_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;
let memory = null;
let pending = null;

function readCache() {
  if (memory && Date.now() - memory.savedAt < CLIENT_TTL) return memory;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(window.sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY) || "null");
    if (parsed?.data?.usd_to_syp && Date.now() - parsed.savedAt < CLIENT_TTL) {
      memory = parsed;
      return parsed;
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

async function loadRate({ force = false } = {}) {
  const cached = force ? null : readCache();
  if (cached) return cached.data;
  if (!pending) {
    pending = apiFetch("/api/exchange-rate")
      .then((data) => {
        memory = { data, savedAt: Date.now() };
        try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(memory)); } catch {}
        return data;
      })
      .finally(() => { pending = null; });
  }
  return pending;
}

export default function useExchangeRate() {
  const cached = readCache();
  const [state, setState] = useState({ data: cached?.data || null, loading: !cached, error: null });

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;

    const refresh = (force = false) => {
      loadRate({ force })
        .then((data) => alive && setState({ data, loading: false, error: null }))
        .catch((error) => alive && setState((current) => ({ ...current, loading: false, error })));
    };

    refresh(false);

    // Keep an already-open storefront in sync with the live exchange source.
    const intervalId = window.setInterval(() => refresh(true), CLIENT_TTL);
    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") refresh(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

    return () => {
      alive = false;
      window.clearInterval(intervalId);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    };
  }, []);

  return state;
}


===== FILE: \resources\js\lib\api.js =====
export function csrfToken() {
  return document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.getAttribute("content") || "";
}

export async function apiFetch(url, options = {}) {
  const headers = new Headers(options.headers || {});
  headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
  if (options.body && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
  const token = csrfToken();
  if (token) headers.set("X-CSRF-TOKEN", token);

  const response = await fetch(url, {
    credentials: "same-origin",
    ...options,
    headers,
  });

  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  const data = contentType.includes("application/json") ? await response.json() : null;
  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = new Error(data?.message || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    error.status = response.status;
    error.data = data;
    throw error;
  }
  return data;
}


===== FILE: \resources\js\lib\permissions.js =====
export function effectivePermissions(user) {
  if (!user) return [];
  const permissions = Array.isArray(user.effective_permissions) ? user.effective_permissions : [];
  return permissions;
}

export function hasPermission(user, permission) {
  const permissions = effectivePermissions(user);
  return permissions.includes("*") || permissions.includes(permission);
}

export function hasAnyPermission(user, permissions = []) {
  return permissions.some((permission) => hasPermission(user, permission));
}

===== FILE: \tests\Feature\AdminWorkspacePermissionTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AdminWorkspacePermissionTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_session_exposes_only_effective_permissions_for_admin(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->makeAdmin(['orders.view', 'products.view']);

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->getJson('/auth/session');

        $response->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('user.role', 'admin')
            ->assertJsonPath('user.is_primary_admin', false)
            ->assertJsonPath('user.account_status', 'active')
            ->assertJsonCount(2, 'user.effective_permissions');

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(
            ['orders.view', 'products.view'],
            $response->json('user.effective_permissions')
        );
    }

    public function test_primary_admin_does_not_receive_unassigned_permissions_implicitly(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->makeAdmin(['orders.view']);
        $admin->forceFill(['is_primary_admin' => true])->save();
        $admin->refresh();

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/orders')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/products')->assertRedirect('/admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/operations')->assertRedirect('/admin');

        $session = $this->actingAs($admin)->getJson('/auth/session')->assertOk();
        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(['orders.view'], $session->json('user.effective_permissions'));
    }

    public function test_admin_dashboard_is_available_without_analytics_permission(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->makeAdmin(['orders.view']);

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->getJson('/api/dashboard')->assertForbidden();
    }

    public function test_admin_workspace_routes_are_enforced_server_side_without_showing_error_page(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->makeAdmin(['orders.view']);

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/orders')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/products')->assertRedirect('/admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/team')->assertRedirect('/admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/operations')->assertRedirect('/admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/delivery')->assertRedirect('/admin');

        // API security stays strict even though browser pages redirect quietly.
        $this->actingAs($admin)->getJson('/api/admin/products')->assertForbidden();
    }

    public function test_granted_workspace_becomes_available_without_changing_role(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->makeAdmin(['orders.view', 'delivery.view']);

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/orders')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/delivery')->assertOk();
    }

    private function makeAdmin(array $permissions): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $user->forceFill([
            'name' => 'Permission Test Admin',
            'email' => 'permission-admin-'.uniqid().'@example.com',
            'phone' => '+9639'.random_int(10000000, 99999999),
            'role' => 'admin',
            'password' => 'Password123!',
            'account_status' => 'active',
            'is_primary_admin' => false,
            'permissions' => $permissions,
        ])->save();

        return $user->fresh();
    }
}


===== FILE: \tests\Feature\AuthEmailVerificationPasswordResetTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\AuthCode;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\EmailVerificationCodeNotification;
use App\Notifications\PasswordResetCodeNotification;
use App\Services\AuthCodeService;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AuthEmailVerificationPasswordResetTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_customer_registration_requires_email_and_sends_verification_code(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();

        $response = $this->postJson('/auth/register', [
            'name' => 'Customer Test',
            'phone' => '0999000011',
            'email' => 'customer@example.com',
            'password' => 'StrongPass123',
            'password_confirmation' => 'StrongPass123',
        ]);

        $response->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('verification_required', true);

        $user = User::where('email', 'customer@example.com')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertNull($user->email_verified_at);

        Notification::assertSentTo($user, EmailVerificationCodeNotification::class);
    }

    public function test_customer_can_verify_email_with_six_digit_code(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();

        $this->postJson('/auth/register', [
            'name' => 'Customer Test',
            'phone' => '0999000012',
            'email' => 'verify@example.com',
            'password' => 'StrongPass123',
            'password_confirmation' => 'StrongPass123',
        ])->assertCreated();

        $user = User::where('email', 'verify@example.com')->firstOrFail();

        $code = null;
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $user,
            EmailVerificationCodeNotification::class,
            function (EmailVerificationCodeNotification $notification) use (&$code) {
                $code = $notification->code;
                return true;
            }
        );

        $this->assertNotNull($code);

        $this->postJson('/auth/email-verification/verify', [
            'code' => $code,
        ])->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('verified', true);

        $this->assertNotNull($user->fresh()->email_verified_at);
    }

    public function test_unverified_customer_is_not_blocked_from_checkout_by_email_verification(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->unverified()->create([
            'role' => 'customer',
            'email' => 'unverified@example.com',
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->postJson('/api/orders', []);

        $this->assertNotSame(403, $response->status());
        $this->assertNotSame('email_verification_required', $response->json('code'));
    }

    public function test_verification_code_expires_and_resend_is_rate_limited(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();

        $user = User::factory()->unverified()->create([
            'role' => 'customer',
            'email' => 'expired@example.com',
        ]);

        AuthCode::create([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'email' => $user->email,
            'purpose' => AuthCodeService::PURPOSE_VERIFY_EMAIL,
            'code_hash' => Hash::make('123456'),
            'expires_at' => now()->subMinute(),
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($user)
            ->postJson('/auth/email-verification/verify', ['code' => '123456'])
            ->assertUnprocessable();

        $this->postJson('/auth/email-verification/send')
            ->assertOk();

        $this->postJson('/auth/email-verification/send')
            ->assertUnprocessable();
    }

    public function test_password_reset_code_changes_password_and_old_password_stops_working(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'role' => 'customer',
            'email' => 'reset@example.com',
            'password' => 'OldPassword123',
        ]);

        $this->postJson('/auth/password/forgot', [
            'email' => $user->email,
        ])->assertOk();

        $code = null;
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $user,
            PasswordResetCodeNotification::class,
            function (PasswordResetCodeNotification $notification) use (&$code) {
                $code = $notification->code;
                return true;
            }
        );

        $this->assertNotNull($code);

        $this->postJson('/auth/password/reset', [
            'email' => $user->email,
            'code' => $code,
            'password' => 'NewPassword123',
            'password_confirmation' => 'NewPassword123',
        ])->assertOk();

        $user->refresh();
        $this->assertTrue(Hash::check('NewPassword123', $user->password));
        $this->assertFalse(Hash::check('OldPassword123', $user->password));
    }

    public function test_forgot_password_does_not_reveal_if_email_exists(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();

        $this->postJson('/auth/password/forgot', [
            'email' => 'does-not-exist@example.com',
        ])->assertOk()
            ->assertJson([
                'message' => 'إذا كان البريد مسجلاً لدينا، سيصلك رمز إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور.',
            ]);

        Notification::assertNothingSent();
    }
}


===== FILE: \tests\Feature\DataScopeDelegationTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\CatalogProduct;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderItem;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class DataScopeDelegationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_owner_can_create_section_scoped_admin_and_scope_filters_products_and_orders(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');

        $this->actingAs($owner)->postJson('/api/team', [
            'name' => 'Decoration Admin',
            'email' => 'decor@example.com',
            'phone' => '+963900000002',
            'role' => 'admin',
            'password' => 'Password123!',
            'permissions' => ['products.view', 'orders.view'],
            'data_scopes' => [
                'products' => ['mode' => 'section', 'values' => ['decor']],
                'orders' => ['mode' => 'section', 'values' => ['decor']],
            ],
        ])->assertCreated();

        $admin = User::where('email', 'decor@example.com')->firstOrFail();

        CatalogProduct::create([
            'external_id' => 'DECOR-1', 'name_ar' => 'Decor', 'name_en' => 'Decor',
            'category' => 'decor', 'world' => 'baby', 'price_usd' => 20, 'status' => 'active',
        ]);
        CatalogProduct::create([
            'external_id' => 'BOYS-1', 'name_ar' => 'Boys', 'name_en' => 'Boys',
            'category' => 'boys', 'world' => 'fashion', 'price_usd' => 15, 'status' => 'active',
        ]);

        $decorOrder = $this->makeOrder('ORDER-DECOR', 'decor');
        $boysOrder = $this->makeOrder('ORDER-BOYS', 'boys');

        $products = $this->actingAs($admin)->getJson('/api/admin/products')->assertOk()->json('products');
        $this->assertCount(1, $products);
        $this->assertSame('DECOR-1', (string) $products[0]['id']);

        $orders = $this->actingAs($admin)->getJson('/api/admin/orders')->assertOk()->json('orders');
        $this->assertCount(1, $orders);
        $this->assertSame($decorOrder->id, $orders[0]['id']);
        $this->assertNotSame($boysOrder->id, $orders[0]['id']);
    }

    public function test_admin_cannot_delegate_permission_or_scope_broader_than_own(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');

    public function test_admin_with_create_admin_can_create_child_without_manage_permissions(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');
        $admin = $this->makeUser('admin', 'creator@example.com', '+963900000002', [
            'permissions' => ['team.view', 'team.create_admin', 'products.view'],
            'data_scopes' => [
                'products' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
                'orders' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
                'customers' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
                'delivery' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
            ],
            'created_by' => $owner->id,
        ]);

        $team = $this->actingAs($admin)->getJson('/api/team')->assertOk();
        $this->assertContains('admin', $team->json('creatable_roles'));

        $this->actingAs($admin)->postJson('/api/team', [
            'name' => 'Child Admin',
            'email' => 'child@example.com',
            'phone' => '+963900000003',
            'role' => 'admin',
            'password' => 'Password123!',
            'permissions' => ['products.view'],
            'data_scopes' => [
                'products' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
            ],
        ])->assertCreated();

        $child = User::where('email', 'child@example.com')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame(['products.view'], $child->permissions);
    }

    public function test_delivery_assigned_scope_only_returns_own_orders(): void
    {
        $driver = $this->makeUser('delivery', 'driver@example.com', '+963900000010', [
            'permissions' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
            'data_scopes' => [
                'orders' => ['mode' => 'assigned', 'values' => []],
                'customers' => ['mode' => 'related', 'values' => []],
            ],
        ]);
        $other = $this->makeUser('delivery', 'other@example.com', '+963900000011', [
            'permissions' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
        ]);

        $mine = $this->makeOrder('MINE', 'boys', $driver->id, 'assigned_to_driver');
        $this->makeOrder('OTHER', 'boys', $other->id, 'assigned_to_driver');

        $orders = $this->actingAs($driver)->getJson('/api/delivery/orders')->assertOk()->json('orders');
        $this->assertCount(1, $orders);
        $this->assertSame($mine->id, $orders[0]['id']);
    }

    public function test_section_scoped_admin_cannot_modify_out_of_scope_order(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->makeUser('admin', 'decor@example.com', '+963900000020', [
            'permissions' => ['orders.view', 'orders.accept'],
            'data_scopes' => [
                'orders' => ['mode' => 'section', 'values' => ['decor']],
                'products' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
                'customers' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
                'delivery' => ['mode' => 'all', 'values' => []],
            ],
        ]);

        $outside = $this->makeOrder('OUTSIDE', 'boys');
        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->postJson('/api/admin/orders/'.$outside->id.'/accept')
            ->assertForbidden();
    }

    private function makeOrder(string $reference, string $category, ?int $driverId = null, string $status = 'pending_review'): Order
    {
        $order = Order::create([
            'reference' => $reference,
            'assigned_delivery_id' => $driverId,
            'status' => $status,
            'customer_name' => 'Customer',
            'customer_phone' => '+963955000000',
            'delivery_address' => 'Address',
            'subtotal_usd' => 10,
            'discount_usd' => 0,
            'total_usd' => 10,
        ]);

        OrderItem::create([
            'order_id' => $order->id,
            'product_external_id' => $reference.'-P',
            'name_ar' => 'Item',
            'quantity' => 1,
            'unit_price_usd' => 10,
            'line_total_usd' => 10,
            'category' => $category,
            'sections' => [],
            'is_offer' => false,
        ]);

        return $order;
    }

    private function makeUser(string $role, string $email, string $phone, array $extra = []): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create(['email' => $email]);
        $user->forceFill(array_merge([
            'name' => ucfirst($role),
            'email' => $email,
            'phone' => $phone,
            'role' => $role,
            'password' => 'Password123!',
            'account_status' => 'active',
            'is_primary_admin' => false,
            'permissions' => $role === 'owner' ? [] : ['orders.view'],
            'data_scopes' => null,
        ], $extra))->save();
        return $user->fresh();
    }
}

===== FILE: \tests\Feature\FinancialLedgerDebtTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\FinancialLedgerEntry;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\CommissionService;
use App\Services\FinancialLedgerService;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class FinancialLedgerDebtTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_normal_commission_becomes_negative_admin_balance_only_after_customer_confirmation(): void
    {
        [$admin, $customer, $order] = $this->makeDeliveredOrder();

        $commission = app(CommissionService::class)->ensureForDeliveredOrder($order);
        $this->assertSame('awaiting_confirmation', $commission->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, FinancialLedgerEntry::count());

        $order->update(['customer_confirmed_at' => now()]);
        $commission = app(CommissionService::class)->ensureForDeliveredOrder($order->fresh());

        $this->assertSame('pending', $commission->status);
        $this->assertSame($admin->id, $commission->debtor_user_id);
        $this->assertSame(-0.5, app(FinancialLedgerService::class)->balanceFor($admin));
        $this->assertSame(0.5, app(FinancialLedgerService::class)->dueFor($admin));

        app(CommissionService::class)->ensureForDeliveredOrder($order->fresh());
        $this->assertSame(1, FinancialLedgerEntry::where('type', 'commission')->count());
    }

    public function test_customer_confirmation_endpoint_accrues_commission(): void
    {
        [$admin, $customer, $order] = $this->makeDeliveredOrder();

        $this->actingAs($customer)
            ->postJson('/api/orders/'.$order->id.'/confirm-receipt')
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertNotNull($order->fresh()->customer_confirmed_at);
        $this->assertSame(-0.5, app(FinancialLedgerService::class)->balanceFor($admin));
    }

    public function test_owner_can_record_partial_then_full_settlement(): void
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'owner']);
        [$admin, $customer, $orderOne] = $this->makeDeliveredOrder();
        $orderOne->update(['customer_confirmed_at' => now()]);
        app(CommissionService::class)->ensureForDeliveredOrder($orderOne->fresh());

        [, , $orderTwo] = $this->makeDeliveredOrder($admin, $customer);
        $orderTwo->update(['customer_confirmed_at' => now()]);
        app(CommissionService::class)->ensureForDeliveredOrder($orderTwo->fresh());

        $ledger = app(FinancialLedgerService::class);
        $this->assertSame(-1.0, $ledger->balanceFor($admin));

        $first = $ledger->recordSettlement($admin, $owner, 0.50, 'TEST-1');
        $this->assertSame(1, $first->orders_count);
        $this->assertSame(-0.5, $ledger->balanceFor($admin));

        $ledger->recordSettlement($admin, $owner, 0.50, 'TEST-2');
        $this->assertSame(0.0, $ledger->balanceFor($admin));
        $this->assertSame(0.0, $ledger->dueFor($admin));
    }

    public function test_return_creates_positive_reversal_instead_of_deleting_original_charge(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $order] = $this->makeDeliveredOrder();
        $order->update(['customer_confirmed_at' => now()]);

        $service = app(CommissionService::class);
        $service->ensureForDeliveredOrder($order->fresh());
        $this->assertSame(-0.5, app(FinancialLedgerService::class)->balanceFor($admin));

        $service->reverseForReturnedOrder($order->fresh(), 'Test return');

        $this->assertSame(0.0, app(FinancialLedgerService::class)->balanceFor($admin));
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('financial_ledger_entries', ['type' => 'commission']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('financial_ledger_entries', ['type' => 'commission_reversal']);
    }

    public function test_decoration_is_deferred_and_does_not_change_normal_admin_balance(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $order] = $this->makeDeliveredOrder();
        $order->items()->update(['category' => 'decor']);
        $order->update(['customer_confirmed_at' => now()]);

        $commission = app(CommissionService::class)->ensureForDeliveredOrder($order->fresh());

        $this->assertSame('deferred', $commission->status);
        $this->assertSame('decoration_deferred', $commission->type);
        $this->assertSame(0.0, app(FinancialLedgerService::class)->balanceFor($admin));
    }

    private function makeDeliveredOrder(?User $admin = null, ?User $customer = null): array
    {
        $admin ??= User::factory()->create([
            'role' => 'admin',
            'account_status' => 'active',
            'is_primary_admin' => true,
        ]);
        $customer ??= User::factory()->create(['role' => 'customer']);

        $order = Order::create([
            'reference' => 'TEST-'.uniqid(),
            'user_id' => $customer->id,
            'status' => 'delivered',
            'customer_name' => 'Test Customer',
            'customer_phone' => '0999000000',
            'delivery_address' => 'Test address',
            'subtotal_usd' => 10,
            'discount_usd' => 0,
            'total_usd' => 10,
            'accepted_at' => now()->subHour(),
            'accepted_by_user_id' => $admin->id,
            'delivered_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $order->items()->create([
            'product_external_id' => 'P-1',
            'name_en' => 'Test product',
            'quantity' => 1,
            'unit_price_usd' => 10,
            'line_total_usd' => 10,
            'category' => 'clothes',
            'sections' => [],
            'is_offer' => false,
        ]);

        return [$admin, $customer, $order];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\ExchangeRateService;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class GuestCheckoutTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_guest_can_submit_order_without_email_verification(): void
    {
        $this->mock(ExchangeRateService::class, function ($mock): void {
            $mock->shouldReceive('current')->once()->andReturn([
                'usd_to_syp' => 10000,
                'source' => 'test',
            ]);
            $mock->shouldReceive('convertUsdToSyp')
                ->once()
                ->with(23.5, \Mockery::type('array'))
                ->andReturn(235000);
        });

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/orders', [
            'customer_name' => 'Guest Customer',
            'customer_phone' => '0999000022',
            'delivery_address' => 'Guest test address',
            'customer_note' => null,
            'coupon_code' => null,
            'payment_currency' => 'usd',
            'fulfillment_method' => 'delivery',
            'delivery_zone' => 'damascus',
            'items' => [[
                'product_id' => 'guest-test-product',
                'name_ar' => 'منتج اختبار',
                'name_en' => 'Test product',
                'image' => null,
                'color_id' => null,
                'color_name' => null,
                'size' => null,
                'quantity' => 1,
                'unit_price_usd' => 21,
                'category' => 'test',
                'sections' => [],
            ]],
        ]);

        $response->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('order.user_id', null)
            ->assertJsonPath('order.status', 'pending_review')
            ->assertJsonPath('order.payment_currency', 'usd');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('orders', [
            'customer_phone' => '0999000022',
            'user_id' => null,
            'delivery_fee_usd' => 2.50,
            'total_usd' => 23.50,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_unverified_customer_can_order_and_order_stays_attached_to_account(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->unverified()->create([
            'role' => 'customer',
            'email' => 'unverified-order@example.com',
        ]);

        $this->mock(ExchangeRateService::class, function ($mock): void {
            $mock->shouldReceive('current')->once()->andReturn([
                'usd_to_syp' => 10000,
                'source' => 'test',
            ]);
            $mock->shouldReceive('convertUsdToSyp')
                ->once()
                ->with(12.5, \Mockery::type('array'))
                ->andReturn(125000);
        });

        $this->actingAs($user)
            ->postJson('/api/orders', [
                'customer_name' => 'Unverified Customer',
                'customer_phone' => '0999000033',
                'delivery_address' => 'Account order address',
                'payment_currency' => 'syp',
                'fulfillment_method' => 'delivery',
                'delivery_zone' => 'damascus',
                'items' => [[
                    'product_id' => 'account-order-product',
                    'quantity' => 1,
                    'unit_price_usd' => 10,
                    'sections' => [],
                ]],
            ])
            ->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('order.user_id', $user->id)
            ->assertJsonPath('order.payment_currency', 'syp');
    }
}

===== FILE: \tests\Feature\RoleDashboardStorefrontAccessTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class RoleDashboardStorefrontAccessTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function user(string $role, array $permissions = [], bool $storefrontAccess = true): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => $role]);
        $user->forceFill([
            'account_status' => 'active',
            'permissions' => $permissions,
            'storefront_access' => $storefrontAccess,
        ])->save();

        return $user->fresh();
    }

    public function test_every_role_has_its_own_dashboard_route(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->user('owner');
        $admin = $this->user('admin', ['products.view'], false);
        $delivery = $this->user('delivery', ['delivery.orders.view'], false);
        $customer = $this->user('customer');

        $this->actingAs($owner)->get('/owner')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($delivery)->get('/delivery')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($customer)->get('/customer')->assertOk();
    }

    public function test_owner_can_choose_dashboard_only_or_storefront_for_staff(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->user('owner');

        $response = $this->actingAs($owner)->postJson('/api/team', [
            'name' => 'Store Admin',
            'email' => 'store-admin@example.test',
            'phone' => '0999000111',
            'role' => 'admin',
            'password' => 'password123',
            'permissions' => ['products.view'],
            'data_scopes' => [],
            'storefront_access' => true,
        ])->assertCreated();

        $this->assertTrue((bool) $response->json('user.storefront_access'));
        $admin = User::where('email', 'store-admin@example.test')->firstOrFail();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/')->assertOk();

        $admin->forceFill(['storefront_access' => false])->save();
        $this->actingAs($admin->fresh())->get('/')->assertRedirect('/admin');
    }

    public function test_delegated_admin_cannot_grant_storefront_access(): void
    {
        $actor = $this->user('admin', ['team.view', 'team.create_admin', 'products.view'], false);

        $this->actingAs($actor)->postJson('/api/team', [
            'name' => 'Child Admin',
            'email' => 'child-admin@example.test',
            'phone' => '0999000222',
            'role' => 'admin',
            'password' => 'password123',
            'permissions' => ['products.view'],
            'data_scopes' => [],
            'storefront_access' => true,
        ])->assertCreated();

        $child = User::where('email', 'child-admin@example.test')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertFalse((bool) $child->storefront_access);
        $this->actingAs($child)->get('/')->assertRedirect('/admin');
    }
}


===== FILE: \tests\Feature\StaffWorkspaceIsolationTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class StaffWorkspaceIsolationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function staff(string $role, array $permissions = []): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => $role]);
        $user->forceFill([
            'account_status' => 'active',
            'permissions' => $permissions,
        ])->save();

        return $user->fresh();
    }

    public function test_admin_is_redirected_from_public_store_pages_to_admin_workspace(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->staff('admin', ['products.view']);

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/')->assertRedirect('/admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/category/clothing')->assertRedirect('/admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/account')->assertRedirect('/admin');
    }

    public function test_delivery_is_redirected_from_public_store_pages_to_delivery_workspace(): void
    {
        $delivery = $this->staff('delivery', ['delivery.orders.view']);

        $this->actingAs($delivery)->get('/')->assertRedirect('/delivery');
        $this->actingAs($delivery)->get('/category/clothing')->assertRedirect('/delivery');
        $this->actingAs($delivery)->get('/account')->assertRedirect('/delivery');
    }

    public function test_customer_can_still_browse_public_store(): void
    {
        $customer = $this->staff('customer');

        $this->actingAs($customer)->get('/')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($customer)->get('/category/clothing')->assertOk();
    }

    public function test_decoration_admin_can_open_only_granted_decoration_workspace(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->staff('admin', ['decoration.view']);

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/decoration')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/products')->assertRedirect('/admin');
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/operations')->assertRedirect('/admin');
    }

    public function test_admin_without_decoration_permission_is_quietly_returned_to_dashboard(): void
    {
        $admin = $this->staff('admin', ['products.view']);

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/admin/decoration')->assertRedirect('/admin');
    }
}


===== FILE: \tests\Feature\SupportConversationTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\SupportConversation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class SupportConversationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function user(string $role, array $permissions = []): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => $role]);
        $user->forceFill([
            'account_status' => 'active',
            'permissions' => $permissions,
        ])->save();

        return $user->fresh();
    }

    private function orderFor(User $customer, string $reference = 'OMB-SUPPORT-1'): Order
    {
        return Order::create([
            'reference' => $reference,
            'user_id' => $customer->id,
            'status' => 'pending_review',
            'customer_name' => $customer->name,
            'customer_phone' => $customer->phone ?: '0999000000',
            'delivery_address' => 'Support test address',
            'subtotal_usd' => 10,
            'discount_usd' => 0,
            'delivery_fee_usd' => 2.50,
            'total_usd' => 12.50,
            'payment_currency' => 'usd',
            'fulfillment_method' => 'delivery',
            'delivery_zone' => 'damascus',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_guest_can_open_and_continue_conversation_only_with_token(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/support/conversations', [
            'guest_name' => 'Guest Support',
            'guest_phone' => '0999111000',
            'subject' => 'Question',
            'message' => 'Hello from guest.',
        ])->assertCreated();

        $id = (int) $response->json('conversation.id');
        $token = (string) $response->json('conversation.token');

        $this->assertNotSame('', $token);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('support_conversations', [
            'id' => $id,
            'user_id' => null,
            'unread_for_staff' => 1,
            'status' => 'open',
        ]);

        $this->getJson("/api/support/conversations/{$id}?token=wrong-token")
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->getJson("/api/support/conversations/{$id}?token=".urlencode($token))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('conversation.messages.0.body', 'Hello from guest.');

        $this->withHeader('X-Support-Token', $token)
            ->postJson("/api/support/conversations/{$id}/messages", [
                'message' => 'Second guest message.',
                'token' => $token,
            ])
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('support_conversations', [
            'id' => $id,
            'unread_for_staff' => 2,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_customer_can_link_own_order_and_other_customer_cannot_read_thread(): void
    {
        $customer = $this->user('customer');
        $other = $this->user('customer');
        $order = $this->orderFor($customer);

        $response = $this->actingAs($customer)->postJson('/api/support/conversations', [
            'order_id' => $order->id,
            'subject' => 'Order question',
            'message' => 'Where is my order?',
        ])->assertCreated()
          ->assertJsonPath('conversation.order.reference', $order->reference);

        $conversationId = (int) $response->json('conversation.id');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('support_conversations', [
            'id' => $conversationId,
            'user_id' => $customer->id,
            'order_id' => $order->id,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($other)
            ->getJson("/api/support/conversations/{$conversationId}")
            ->assertForbidden();
    }

    public function test_support_permissions_separate_view_reply_assign_and_close(): void
    {
        $guestConversation = SupportConversation::create([
            'public_token' => str_repeat('a', 64),
            'guest_name' => 'Guest',
            'guest_phone' => '0999000001',
            'status' => 'open',
            'unread_for_staff' => 1,
            'last_message_at' => now(),
        ]);
        $guestConversation->messages()->create([
            'sender_type' => 'guest',
            'body' => 'Need help',
        ]);

        $viewOnly = $this->user('admin', ['support.view']);

        $this->actingAs($viewOnly)
            ->getJson('/api/support/staff')
            ->assertOk();

        $this->actingAs($viewOnly)
            ->postJson("/api/support/staff/{$guestConversation->id}/messages", ['message' => 'Nope'])
            ->assertForbidden();

        $supportAdmin = $this->user('admin', [
            'support.view',
            'support.reply',
            'support.assign',
            'support.close',
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($supportAdmin)
            ->postJson("/api/support/staff/{$guestConversation->id}/messages", ['message' => 'We are checking.'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('conversation.status', 'waiting_customer');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('support_conversations', [
            'id' => $guestConversation->id,
            'assigned_to_user_id' => $supportAdmin->id,
            'unread_for_customer' => 1,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($supportAdmin)
            ->postJson("/api/support/staff/{$guestConversation->id}/close", [])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('conversation.status', 'closed');
    }

    public function test_owner_can_access_support_without_explicit_permission(): void
    {
        SupportConversation::create([
            'public_token' => str_repeat('b', 64),
            'guest_name' => 'Guest',
            'guest_phone' => '0999000002',
            'status' => 'open',
            'last_message_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $owner = $this->user('owner');

        $this->actingAs($owner)
            ->get('/owner/support')
            ->assertOk();

        $this->actingAs($owner)
            ->getJson('/api/support/staff')
            ->assertOk();
    }

    public function test_customer_read_clears_staff_reply_unread_counter(): void
    {
        $customer = $this->user('customer');

        $response = $this->actingAs($customer)->postJson('/api/support/conversations', [
            'message' => 'Customer message',
        ])->assertCreated();

        $conversation = SupportConversation::findOrFail($response->json('conversation.id'));
        $owner = $this->user('owner');

        $this->actingAs($owner)
            ->postJson("/api/support/staff/{$conversation->id}/messages", ['message' => 'Owner reply'])
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(1, (int) $conversation->fresh()->unread_for_customer);

        $this->actingAs($customer)
            ->getJson("/api/support/conversations/{$conversation->id}")
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(0, (int) $conversation->fresh()->unread_for_customer);
    }
}


===== FILE: \tests\Feature\TeamManagementSecurityTest.php =====
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\StaffActionLog;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class TeamManagementSecurityTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_owner_can_create_admin_with_normalized_identity_and_permissions(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');

        $response = $this->actingAs($owner)->postJson('/api/team', [
            'name' => 'Real Admin',
            'email' => ' ADMIN@EXAMPLE.COM ',
            'phone' => '+963 900-000-002',
            'role' => 'admin',
            'password' => 'Password123!',
            'permissions' => ['orders.accept'],
        ]);

        $response->assertCreated();

        $admin = User::where('email', 'admin@example.com')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('+963900000002', $admin->phone);
        $this->assertSame('active', $admin->account_status);
        $this->assertContains('orders.view', $admin->permissions);
        $this->assertContains('orders.accept', $admin->permissions);
        $this->assertSame($owner->id, $admin->created_by);
    }

    public function test_owner_can_delete_only_an_unused_non_primary_account(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');
        $admin = $this->makeUser('admin', 'unused@example.com', '+963900000002', [
            'permissions' => ['orders.view'],
            'is_primary_admin' => false,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($owner)
            ->deleteJson('/api/team/'.$admin->id)
            ->assertOk();

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('users', ['id' => $admin->id]);
        $this->assertTrue(
            StaffActionLog::where('target_user_id', $admin->id)->where('action', 'account_deleted')->exists()
        );
    }

    public function test_account_linked_to_an_order_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');
        $delivery = $this->makeUser('delivery', 'driver@example.com', '+963900000003', [
            'permissions' => ['delivery.orders.view'],
        ]);

        Order::create([
            'reference' => 'TEST-ORDER-1',
            'assigned_delivery_id' => $delivery->id,
            'status' => 'accepted',
            'customer_name' => 'Test Customer',
            'customer_phone' => '+963900000099',
            'delivery_address' => 'Test address',
            'subtotal_usd' => 10,
            'discount_usd' => 0,
            'total_usd' => 10,
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($owner)->deleteJson('/api/team/'.$delivery->id);

        $response->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonFragment(['message' => 'This account has linked business data and cannot be permanently deleted. Suspend it instead.']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('users', ['id' => $delivery->id]);
    }


    public function test_owner_can_edit_primary_admin_permissions(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');
        $admin = $this->makeUser('admin', 'primary-edit@example.com', '+963900000002', [
            'is_primary_admin' => true,
            'permissions' => ['orders.view', 'products.view'],
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($owner)
            ->putJson('/api/team/'.$admin->id, [
                'name' => $admin->name,
                'email' => $admin->email,
                'phone' => $admin->phone,
                'permissions' => ['products.view'],
            ])
            ->assertOk();

        $admin->refresh();
        $this->assertTrue((bool) $admin->is_primary_admin);
        $this->assertSame(['products.view'], $admin->permissions);
    }

    public function test_primary_admin_cannot_be_suspended_or_deleted_until_reassigned(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->makeUser('owner', 'owner@example.com', '+963900000001');
        $admin = $this->makeUser('admin', 'primary@example.com', '+963900000002', [
            'is_primary_admin' => true,
            'permissions' => [],
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($owner)
            ->postJson('/api/team/'.$admin->id.'/suspend', ['reason' => 'test'])
            ->assertStatus(422);

        $this->actingAs($owner)
            ->deleteJson('/api/team/'.$admin->id)
            ->assertStatus(422);
    }

    public function test_suspended_account_cannot_log_in(): void
    {
        $user = $this->makeUser('admin', 'blocked@example.com', '+963900000002', [
            'account_status' => 'suspended',
            'password' => 'Password123!',
            'permissions' => ['orders.view'],
        ]);

        $this->postJson('/auth/login', [
            'identifier' => $user->email,
            'password' => 'Password123!',
        ])->assertStatus(403)->assertJsonFragment(['code' => 'account_suspended']);
    }

    private function makeUser(string $role, string $email, string $phone, array $extra = []): User
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email' => $email,
        ]);

        $user->forceFill(array_merge([
            'name' => ucfirst($role),
            'email' => $email,
            'phone' => $phone,
            'role' => $role,
            'password' => 'Password123!',
            'account_status' => 'active',
            'is_primary_admin' => false,
            'permissions' => $role === 'owner' ? [] : ['orders.view'],
        ], $extra))->save();

        return $user->fresh();
    }
}
